scene_zh: 租屋看房 · 情境對話
title_quote: I am calling about the flat on Cedar Street.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏠 租屋看房必用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Viewing a Rental Flat
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄租屋看房情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是從一通電話開始：先問房子還租不租、約星期六早上看房、下樓按門鈴進大廳、坐下來問房租包不包水電與暖氣、進浴室檢查水壓、摸臥室暖氣片的溫度、問夜班室友與養貓規矩、再談押金、合約條款、保證人，最後填申請表等回電。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問價、約時間、檢查設備、談押金與簽合約。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Viewing a Rental Flat' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene starts with a phone call about whether the flat is still rented, books a Saturday viewing, rings the doorbell in the lobby, sits down over the rent sheet to ask what the water, heat and waste charges cover, tests the shower pressure and the bedroom radiator, asks about the night-shift housemate and the pet rules, then works through the deposit, the contract clauses and the guarantor form, and ends with the application papers and the wait for one phone call back. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am calling about the flat on Cedar Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈkɔlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə flæt ɑn ˈsidər striːt/
dialogue.zh: 我打電話來問雪松街那間套房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this is Rachel at the rental desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs ɪz ˈreɪtʃəl æt ðə ˈrɛntəl dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我是租屋櫃台的瑞秋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any chance that apartment is still open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tʃæns ðæt ˌəˈpɑrtmənt ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 那間公寓還有得租嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nobody signed for it yet today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnoʊbədi saɪnd fɔr ɪt jɛt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，今天還沒有人簽下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great news, I saw your listing last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt nuz aɪ sɔ jʊr ˈlɪstɪŋ læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我昨晚看到你貼的廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one caught your eye exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn kɑt jʊr aɪ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 你看到的是哪一間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two bedroom place near the bus stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu ˈbɛdˌrum pleɪs nɪr ðə bʌs stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 公車站牌旁邊那間兩房的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that is number five on our list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt ɪz ˈnʌmbər faɪv ɑn aʊr lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 喔，那間在我們清單上排第五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That flat belongs to a private landlord?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt flæt bɪˈlɔŋz tu ə praɪˈvət ˈlændlɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 那間是私人房東的物件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I manage it for the owner directly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈmænɪdʒ ɪt fɔr ði ˈonər dəˈrɛktli/
dialogue.zh: 我幫業主直接管理這一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long has that flat stood empty?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæz ðæt flæt stʊd ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 那間空了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly three weeks since the last tenant left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli θri wikz sɪns ðə læst ˈtɛnənt lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 上一個房客搬走後，快三週了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three weeks is still a comfortable window.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri wikz ɪz stɪl ə ˈkʌmfortəbəl ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 三週的空檔還算充裕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not wait too long, people call daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt weɪt tu lɔŋ ˈpipəl kɔl ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 別拖太久，天天都有人打電話問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you keep it for a few days?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju kip ɪt fɔr ə fju deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我留幾天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cannot hold flats before a viewing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkɑnɑt hoʊld flæts bɪˈfɔr ə ˈvjuwɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有人看過之前，我們不能先把房子留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, so viewing comes before holding.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd soʊ ˈvjuwɪŋ kʌmz bɪˈfɔr ˈhoʊldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 了解了，要先看房才輪到留房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the rule for every rental here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə rul fɔr ˈɛvri ˈrɛntəl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡每一間物件都是這個規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, I will come and see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf aɪ wɪl kʌm ænd si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有道理，我會親自過去看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, seeing the rooms settles your mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈsizɪŋ ðə rumz ˈsɛtəlz jʊr maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 很好，親眼看過房間你就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many bedrooms does that flat offer?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɛdˌrumz dʌz ðæt flæt ˈɔfər/
dialogue.zh: 那間套房配置幾間臥室？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bedrooms sharing one small bathroom inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɛdˌrumz ˈʃɛrɪŋ wʌn smɔl ˈbæθˌrum ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 兩間臥室，屋內共用一間小浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which floor is number five on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ flɔr ɪz ˈnʌmbər faɪv ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 第五號那間在幾樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third floor, counting six floors total.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd flɔr ˈkaʊntɪŋ sɪks flɔrz ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 三樓，這一棟總共六層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the building have an elevator inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ hæv ən ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 大樓裡面有電梯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two elevators behind the lobby doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ˈɛləˌveɪtərz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈlɑbi dɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 有，大廳門後面藏著兩部電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking comes included with the rental flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ kʌmz ɪnˈkludɪd wɪð ðə ˈrɛntəl flæt/
dialogue.zh: 租這間會附停車位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bike spot, but no car space.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn baɪk spɑt bʌt noʊ kɑr speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 只有一格自行車位，沒有汽車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the monthly rent for that unit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə ˈmʌnθli rɛnt fɔr ðæt ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那一間每月租金多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rent is twelve hundred plus your own bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛnt ɪz twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd plʌs jʊr on bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 房租一千二，水電帳單你自己另外付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does twelve hundred cover water and power?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd ˈkʌvər ˈwɔtər ænd ˈpaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 一千二裡麵包含自來水和電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, each flat has its own separate meters.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ itʃ flæt hæz ɪts on ˈsɛpərət ˈmitərz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，每一間都是獨立的水電表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roughly how much are those extra bills?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌfli haʊ mʌtʃ ɑr ðoʊz ˈɛkstrə bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 那些額外的帳單大概多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ninety in summer, one twenty in winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈnaɪnti ɪn ˈsʌmər wʌn ˈtwɛnti ɪn ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 夏天約九十，冬天差不多一百二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your listing mentions internet inside rooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈlɪstɪŋ ˈmɛnʃənz ˈɪntərˌnɛt ɪnˈsaɪd rumz/
dialogue.zh: 你的廣告上有寫房間附網路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fiber is wired everywhere, box included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪbər ɪz ˈwaɪərd ˈɛvriˌwɛr bɑks ɪnˈkludɪd/
dialogue.zh: 光纖全屋都鋪好了，也附分享器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that box reach the far bedroom too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt bɑks ritʃ ðə fɑr ˈbɛdˌrum tu/
dialogue.zh: 那個分享器涵蓋最裡側那間臥室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signal reaches everywhere except the small balcony.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɡnəl ˈritʃəz ˈɛvriˌwɛr ɪkˈsɛpt ðə smɔl ˈbælkəni/
dialogue.zh: 除了小陽台，屋裡每一個角落都收得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flat comes with furniture already, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flæt kʌmz wɪθ ˈfɜrnɪtʃər ɔlˈrɛdi raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 房子是附傢俱的，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beds and wardrobes stay, tables are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛdz ænd ˈwɔrdˌroʊbz steɪ ˈteɪbəlz ɑr jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 床和衣櫃會留下，桌子要自己準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the window curtains new or old?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈkɜrtənz nu ɔr oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 窗簾是新的還是舊的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washed lately, though three panels need replacing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃt ˈleɪtli ðoʊ θri ˈpænəlz nid rɪˈpleɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 前陣子洗過，不過有三片該換掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How bright is the daylight in mornings?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ braɪt ɪz ðə ˈdeɪˌlaɪt ɪn ˈmɔrnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 早上的採光算不算亮？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright until noon, the big glass faces south.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ʌnˈtɪl nun ðə bɪɡ ɡlæs ˈfeɪsɪz saʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 到中午都很亮，大片玻璃是朝南的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Midnight noise on that street, is it bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdnaɪt nɔɪz ɑn ðæt striːt ɪz ɪt bæd/
dialogue.zh: 那一條街到了半夜吵不吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buses pass until one, then silence again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌsəz pæs ʌnˈtɪl wʌn ðɛn ˈsaɪləns əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 公車會開到一點，之後就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A washing machine stands inside the flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwɑʃɪŋ məˈʃin stændz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə flæt/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣機就擺在房子裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small one under the kitchen counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə smɔl wʌn ˈʌndər ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 有，廚房台面下面放了一台小型的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the kitchen stove run on gas?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈkɪtʃən stoʊv rʌn ɑn ɡæs/
dialogue.zh: 廚房的爐台是用瓦斯的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gas cooktop, electric oven, both work fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡæs ˈkʊkˌtɑp ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈʌvən boʊθ wɜrk faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 瓦斯爐面加電烤箱，兩樣都正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deposit required before the viewing today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈpɑzɪt rɪˈkwaɪərd bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天看房之前就要先繳押金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No money changes hands until you decide.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈmʌni ˈtʃeɪndʒəz hændz ʌnˈtɪl ju dɪˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你點頭之前，半毛錢都不用繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then when does the deposit get paid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɛn dʌz ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt ɡɛt peɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那押金是什麼時候付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On signing, usually two months upfront.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈsaɪnɪŋ ˈjuʒəwəli tu mʌnθs ˈʌpfrʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 簽合約那天，通常是兩個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two months deposit feels heavy for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌnθs dɪˈpɑzɪt filz ˈhɛvi fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 兩個月押金對我來說是重了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One month is possible with a good record.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mʌnθ ɪz ˈpɑsəbəl wɪθ ə ɡʊd ˈrɛkərd/
dialogue.zh: 繳費紀錄好的話，收一個月也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What records does the landlord want there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈrɛkərdz dʌz ðə ˈlændlɔrd wɑnt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 房東會想要哪些文件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof of income plus your old landlord letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /pruf ʌv ˈɪnkʌm plʌs jʊr oʊld ˈlændlɔrd ˈlɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 收入證明，再加上前房東寫的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can show pay slips from last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ʃoʊ peɪ slɪps frʌm læst jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 去年的薪資單我拿得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps, the owner likes tidy paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps ði ˈonər laɪks ˈtaɪdi ˈpeɪpərˌwɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 那有幫助，業主喜歡文件整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people viewed that flat already?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl vjud ðæt flæt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 已經有幾個人去看過那間了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four came Saturday, two liked it a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr keɪm ˈsætərˌdeɪ tu laɪkt ɪt ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 週六來了四位，其中兩個很有興趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I hurry because of those viewers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈhɜri bɪˈkɔz ʌv ðoʊz ˈvjuzərz/
dialogue.zh: 因為那些競爭者，我得抓快一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Decide by Friday and you will be fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsaɪd baɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ænd ju wɪl bi faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 週五以前拍板，就來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A twelve month lease, or longer than that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə twɛlv mʌnθ lis ɔr ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 租約寫十二個月，還是能更久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve months, with an option to renew.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv mʌnθs wɪð ən ˈɑpʃən tu rɪˈnu/
dialogue.zh: 十二個月，之後有續約的選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if I leave before twelve months?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz ɪf aɪ liv bɪˈfɔr twɛlv mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 如果沒滿十二個月就搬走會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You still owe rent for two remaining months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju stɪl oʊ rɛnt fɔr tu rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 剩下兩個月的房租你還是要繳清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the owner accept a flatmate instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði ˈonər ɪkˈsɛpt ə ˈflætˌmeɪt ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 房東願意讓合租的人接手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with written notice and a new form.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪθ ˈrɪtən ˈnoʊtɪs ænd ə nu fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要用書面告知並重填表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who answers maintenance calls at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈænsərz ˈmeɪntənəns kɔlz æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 半夜東西壞了要打電話給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A caretaker on call, number on your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɛrˌteɪkər ɑn kɔl ˈnʌmbər ɑn jʊr dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 有值班的管理員，電話貼在你門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot water steady in that small bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ˈwɔtər ˈstɛdi ɪn ðæt smɔl ˈbæθˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 那間小浴室的熱水穩定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pressure is strong, we will test it together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɛʃər ɪz strɔŋ wi wɪl tɛst ɪt təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 水壓很夠，到時我們一起打開試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Testing is good, I trust my own eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛstɪŋ ɪz ɡʊd aɪ trʌst maɪ on aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 能測試最好，我比較相信自己看的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a phone and one patient afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ə foʊn ænd wʌn ˈpeɪʃənt ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 帶一支手機，還有慢慢看的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe around the neighborhood after ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf əˈraʊnd ðə ˈneɪbərˌhʊd ˈæftər tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點過後那一帶還算安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shops stay lit, the street feels calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑps steɪ lɪt ðə striːt filz kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 店門口都還亮著，街道很平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do people throw trash near there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ˈpipəl θroʊ træʃ nɪr ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那附近的垃圾都丟到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bins sit by the back entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɪnz sɪt baɪ ðə bæk ˈɛntrəns/
dialogue.zh: 後門口那邊擱了兩個垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are deliveries left at the main door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr dɪˈlɪvəriz lɛft æt ðə meɪn dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 包裹會放在正門口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most parcels wait at the lobby shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpɑrsəlz weɪt æt ðə ˈlɑbi ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 大部分包裹都擱在大廳的架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mail delivered to every single flat there?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪl dɪˈlɪvərd tu ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl flæt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 信件會投進每一戶的信箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your own box, key sold separately.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊr on bɑks ki soʊld ˈsɛpərətli/
dialogue.zh: 會，你有專屬信箱，鑰匙另買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a reference right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈrɛfərəns raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就需要推薦人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, bring it when you apply.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ brɪŋ ɪt wɛn ju əˈplaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，等你遞申請時再帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then I need a viewing appointment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn aɪ nid ə ˈvjuwɪŋ əˈpɔɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我得排一個看房時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I have slots this coming weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ hæv slɑts ðɪs ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 剛好，這個週末我還有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday or Sunday, which works for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ɔr ˈsʌnˌdeɪ wɪtʃ wɜrks fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 週六或週日，你哪天方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both days work; mornings fill first though.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ deɪz wɜrk ˈmɔrnɪŋz fɪl fɜrst ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩天都可以，只是上午的時段先滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning fits around my other plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ fɪts əˈraʊnd maɪ ˈʌðər plænz/
dialogue.zh: 週六上午剛好能塞進我的安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine thirty or eleven, pick one please.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrti ɔr ɪˈlɛvən pɪk wʌn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 九點半或十一點，請挑一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine thirty sounds calm enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrti saʊndz kɑm ɪˈnʌf fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 九點半剛好，我不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked, my note says Kevin from Cedar Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt maɪ noʊt sɛz ˈkɛvɪn frʌm ˈsidər striːt/
dialogue.zh: 登記好了，我寫著雪松街的凱文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone number is the same you see.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ˈnʌmbər ɪz ðə seɪm ju si/
dialogue.zh: 我的電話就是你現在撥的這支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me if Saturday morning changes suddenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈtʃeɪndʒəz ˈsʌdənli/
dialogue.zh: 週六上午臨時有變，傳訊跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Address, gate code, and floor, please confirm.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈdrɛs ɡeɪt koʊd ænd flɔr pliz kənˈfɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 地址、門禁碼還有樓層，再麻煩確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cedar Street number twelve, third floor flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsidər striːt ˈnʌmbər twɛlv θɜrd flɔr flæt/
dialogue.zh: 雪松街十二號，三樓那一戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine thirty, Cedar twelve, I have it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrti ˈsidər twɛlv aɪ hæv ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 九點半、十二號，我記牢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you then, wear shoes you can walk in.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ðɛn wɛr ʃuz ju kən wɔk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 到時見，鞋子要挑好走的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, before we hang up, one thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt bɪˈfɔr wi hæŋ ʌp wʌn θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，掛電話前還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask me anything about the viewing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr æsk mi ˈɛniθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，看房的事隨便問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one viewing usually take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz wʌn ˈvjuwɪŋ ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一次看房通常要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, longer if you ask details.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈlɔŋɡər ɪf ju æsk dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，問細項就會再久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my sister along Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ brɪŋ maɪ ˈsɪstər əˈlɔŋ ˈsætərˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週六我可以帶我妹妹一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people is fine, three feels crowded.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl ɪz faɪn θri filz ˈkraʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人沒問題，三個人會太擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She checks rooms faster than I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi tʃɛks rumz ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ du/
dialogue.zh: 她看房子比我看得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she can count the electrical outlets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi kən kaʊnt ði ɪˈlɛktrɪkəl ˈaʊtləts/
dialogue.zh: 那她順便幫數牆上插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we will arrive a bit early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wi wɪl əˈraɪv ə bɪt ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們會早一點到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not come before nine fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt kʌm bɪˈfɔr naɪn fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 請別在九點十五之前現身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that, is the owner present?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðæt ɪz ði ˈonər ˈprɛzənt/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？業主會在現場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am still unlocking the lobby until then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm stɪl ʌnˈlɑkɪŋ ðə ˈlɑbi ʌnˈtɪl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我那時還在開大廳的門，早到只能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain is forecast, does that change plans?
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɪz ˈfɔrkæst dʌz ðæt tʃeɪndʒ plænz/
dialogue.zh: 預報說有雨，會影響看屋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the viewing stays unless streets flood.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ steɪz ʌnˈlɛs striːts flʌd/
dialogue.zh: 不會，除非馬路淹水才暫停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Umbrellas we will carry, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌmˈbrɛləz wi wɪl ˈkæri noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 雨傘我們會帶，沒有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also bring shoes that can climb wet stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ brɪŋ ʃuz ðæt kən klaɪm wɛt stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 也記得穿好踩濕樓梯的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine thirty means leaving home at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrti minz ˈlivɪŋ hoʊm æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 九點半表示我八點就得出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus from your side takes twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs frʌm jʊr saɪd teɪks ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 從你那邊搭公車要二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take the subway instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ðə ˈsʌbˌweɪ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我改成搭地鐵會不會比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Subway drops you two blocks closer, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌbˌweɪ drɑps ju tu blɑks ˈkloʊsər jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 地鐵站下車離大樓只有兩個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a bike rack downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə baɪk ræk ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 樓下有自行車架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four racks stand beside the garbage bins.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ræks stænd bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈɡɑrbɪdʒ bɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 有四個架子，就在垃圾桶旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking on the street costs money?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɑn ðə striːt kɔsts ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 路邊停車要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paid until six, free after that hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd ʌnˈtɪl sɪks fri ˈæftər ðæt ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 六點前要繳費，之後隨意停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we view the second flat too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi vju ðə ˈsɛkənd flæt tu/
dialogue.zh: 第二間也能一起看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is rented already, last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈrɛntəd ɔlˈrɛdi læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 那一間上週就租掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which listing went before that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈlɪstɪŋ wɛnt bɪˈfɔr ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 之前是先租出哪一間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The quiet flat near the bakery corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwaɪət flæt nɪr ðə ˈbeɪkəri ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 就是麵包店轉角那間安靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, Cedar Street is my only visit now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈsidər striːt ɪz maɪ ˈoʊnli ˈvɪzɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那雪松街就成了我唯一的一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will make that visit count fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl meɪk ðæt ˈvɪzɪt kaʊnt ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 我們會讓這一趟看得值回票價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who exactly meets me at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪɡˈzæktli miːts mi æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 到門口接我的是哪一位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me, in a green coat, holding keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi ɪn ə ɡrin koʊt ˈhoʊldɪŋ kiz/
dialogue.zh: 是我，穿綠外套，手裡拿著鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you wear a name badge maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju wɛr ə neɪm bædʒ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 你會別一個名牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus I will message when I arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs aɪ wɪl ˈmɛsɪdʒ wɛn aɪ əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 會，而且我到樓下會先傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Message me on this phone, correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛsɪdʒ mi ɑn ðɪs foʊn kəˈrɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 訊息傳到這支電話就對了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text is better, my calls run long.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪz ˈbɛtər maɪ kɔlz rʌn lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 用文字最好，我講電話都很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your photo online shows short hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌɑnˈlaɪn ʃoʊz ʃɔrt hɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你網路上的照片是短髮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, short hair and one silver earring.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃɔrt hɛr ænd wʌn ˈsɪlvər ˈɪrɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，短髮，一邊戴銀色耳環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that helps in a crowded lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðæt hɛlps ɪn ə ˈkraʊdɪd ˈlɑbi/
dialogue.zh: 很好，大廳人多時我認得出你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will also stand near the elevator bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈɔlsoʊ stænd nɪr ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我也會靠在電梯口那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elevator bank, what does that mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛləˌveɪtər bæŋk wʌt dʌz ðæt min/
dialogue.zh: 電梯口那一排是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two elevators facing the mailboxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu ˈɛləˌveɪtərz ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə ˈmeɪlˌbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 就是信箱正對面的那兩部電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we meet outside or inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi mit ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɔr ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我們在門外碰面還是門內？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside, the lobby door needs a code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈlɑbi dɔr nidz ə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 外面，大廳的門要密碼才開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you unlock that code?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm du ju ʌnˈlɑk ðæt koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 你幾點會輸入那組密碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight forty five, exactly, not earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈfɔrti faɪv ɪɡˈzæktli nɑt ˈɜrliər/
dialogue.zh: 八點四十五整，不會更早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will walk over at nine fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wɪl wɔk ˈoʊvər æt naɪn fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我九點十五走過去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee cart sits two doors down, useful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi kɑrt sɪts tu dɔrz daʊn ˈjuzfəl/
dialogue.zh: 隔兩家有個咖啡車，正好買一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the viewing include basement storage?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ ɪnˈklud ˈbeɪsmənt ˈstɔrɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 看房會帶看地下室儲存位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we will find your assigned locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi wɪl faɪnd jʊr əˈsaɪnd ˈlɑkər/
dialogue.zh: 會，我們去找隸屬於你的那個儲藏櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is that storage locker?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪɡ ɪz ðæt ˈstɔrɪdʒ ˈlɑkər/
dialogue.zh: 那個儲藏櫃有多大？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two suitcases stacked sideways just fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsutˌkæsəz stækt ˈsaɪdˌweɪz dʒʌst fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 橫著疊兩個行李箱剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bicycles need space, as you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbaɪsəˌkəz nid speɪs æz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，自行車很佔空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bike room door stays open till ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə baɪk rum dɔr steɪz ˈoʊpən tɪl tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 停車間的門會開到十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my rental contract signed there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈrɛntəl kənˈtrækt saɪnd ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 租屋合約是在現場簽的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not during viewing, paperwork comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈvjuwɪŋ ˈpeɪpərˌwɜrk kʌmz ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 看房時不簽，文件是之後才辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon after the viewing do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ sun ˈæftər ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 看完房子之後多久要簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Decide within three days, then we sign fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsaɪd wɪˈðɪn θri deɪz ðɛn wi saɪn fæst/
dialogue.zh: 三天內決定，後面簽起來很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days works, I must think once.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri deɪz wɜrks aɪ mʌst θɪŋk wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 三天夠用，我需要好好想一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, but tell me by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm bʌt tɛl mi baɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢想，但週五前要讓我知情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday evening is safe for a message.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ˈivnɪŋ ɪz seɪf fɔr ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 週五晚上傳訊息給你正合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read messages before eight in the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rid ˈmɛsɪdəz bɪˈfɔr eɪt ɪn ði ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 我八點前會在辦公室翻訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Office hours, is Saturday morning counted?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfəs ˈaʊərz ɪz ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈkaʊntɪd/
dialogue.zh: 辦公時間裡週六上午也算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday we open at nine, close at one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ wi ˈoʊpən æt naɪn kloʊs æt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 週六九點開門，一點就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One means I must call before noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn minz aɪ mʌst kɔl bɪˈfɔr nun/
dialogue.zh: 一點關門，那我得中午前打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, noon calls reach me best.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt nun kɔlz ritʃ mi bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 對了，中午那通最找得到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring papers to the viewing, or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ˈpeɪpərz tu ðə ˈvjuwɪŋ ɔr nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 看房當天要帶文件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None today, just your questions and a phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn təˈdeɪ dʒʌst jʊr ˈkwɛstʃənz ænd ə foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 一樣都不用，只帶問題跟手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A phone for photos, is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊn fɔr ˈfoʊtoʊz ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 用手機拍照也可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, photograph every outlet and window seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈfoʊtəˌɡræf ˈɛvri ˈaʊtlɛt ænd ˈwɪndoʊ sil/
dialogue.zh: 可以，插座和窗框縫都拍下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window seals show the older damage often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ silz ʃoʊ ði ˈoʊldər ˈdæmɪdʒ ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 窗框縫最常露出舊的毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me those pictures if you spot any.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi ðoʊz ˈpɪktʃərz ɪf ju spɑt ˈɛni/
dialogue.zh: 拍到問題照片就傳給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spotting issues with you standing there feels odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɑtɪŋ ˈɪʃuz wɪð ju ˈstændɪŋ ðɛr filz ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 你站旁邊，我挑毛病有點不自在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait in the hall, giving space.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪt ɪn ðə hɔl ˈɡɪvɪŋ speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我會退到走道等，留空間給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I think slower when people watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ θɪŋk ˈsloʊər wɛn ˈpipəl wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，旁邊有人看著，我就想得慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Viewers should feel free to open drawers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvjuzərz ʃʊd fil fri tu ˈoʊpən drɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 看房的人本來就可以開抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drawers in the kitchen or bedroom too?
dialogue.phonetic: /drɔrz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɔr ˈbɛdˌrum tu/
dialogue.zh: 廚房的抽屜，臥室的也能開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All except the bottom wardrobe drawer, locked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ɪkˈsɛpt ðə ˈbɑtəm ˈwɔrdˌroʊb drɔr lɑkt/
dialogue.zh: 都能開，除了衣櫃最下層那個上鎖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Locked by the landlord or the building?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt baɪ ðə ˈlændlɔrd ɔr ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是房東上鎖還是大樓上鎖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner keeps old tenant things inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈonər kips oʊld ˈtɛnənt θɪŋz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 是業主，裡頭放著前房客的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old tenant things should go before me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈtɛnənt θɪŋz ʃʊd ɡoʊ bɪˈfɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 前房客的東西該在我搬入前清走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, I will note that on my clipboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid aɪ wɪl noʊt ðæt ɑn maɪ ˈklɪpˌbɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 我同意，這點我寫在筆記板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check also whether the hallway light works.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈɔlsoʊ ˈwɛðər ðə ˈhɔˌleɪ laɪt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 也幫我確認走廊的燈亮不亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New bulb last month, it shines steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu bʌlb læst mʌnθ ɪt ʃaɪnz ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 上個月才換燈泡，光很穩定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady light matters, I walk home late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi laɪt ˈmætərz aɪ wɔk hoʊm leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 燈光穩很重要，我常很晚才回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask about the sensor in stairwells.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æsk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɛnsər ɪn ˈstɛrwɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 那就問問樓梯裡的感應燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sensors, motion lights, are those present there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛnsərz ˈmoʊʃən laɪts ɑr ðoʊz ˈprɛzənt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 樓梯間有那種動作感應燈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they wake when anyone climbs slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ weɪk wɛn ˈɛniˌwʌn klaɪmz ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 有，有人慢慢爬也會亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, my list of questions grows long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndərfəl maɪ lɪst ʌv ˈkwɛstʃənz ɡroʊz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的問題清單越列越長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring that list Saturday, we will walk it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðæt lɪst ˈsætərˌdeɪ wi wɪl wɔk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週六帶來，我們邊走邊核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring it printed, screens drain my battery.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt ˈprɪntɪd skrinz dreɪn maɪ ˈbætəri/
dialogue.zh: 我會印出來，螢幕很吃我的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep paper in the lobby basket too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ˈpeɪpər ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi ˈbæskɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 大廳籃子裡我們也放了紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper and pen, clever, I like that plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ænd pɛn ˈklɛvər aɪ laɪk ðæt plæn/
dialogue.zh: 有紙有筆，真貼心，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine thirty Saturday, Cedar twelve, third floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrdi ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈsidər twɛlv θɜrd flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 週六九點半，雪松街十二號三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Repeated out loud helps my shaky memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈpitɪd aʊt laʊd hɛlps maɪ ˈʃeɪki ˈmɛməri/
dialogue.zh: 大聲唸一遍，幫我把記性穩住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text the same line tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛkst ðə seɪm laɪn təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我會把同一句傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text saved, now nothing else to ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst seɪvd naʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls tu æsk/
dialogue.zh: 訊息存好了，沒有別的想問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest well tonight, Saturday is early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rɛst wɛl təˈnaɪt ˈsætərˌdeɪ ɪz ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 那今晚早點休息，週六得很早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you Rachel, Saturday morning then.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈreɪtʃəl ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝瑞秋，那就週六上午見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good luck, I will be at the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʌk aɪ wɪl bi æt ðə ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 路上小心，我會站在那個轉角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am standing at Cedar twelve now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstændɪŋ æt ˈsidər twɛlv naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在站在雪松街十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for the panel beside the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fɔr ðə ˈpænəl bəˈsaɪd ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 去大門旁邊找那一塊對講面板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Panel? There is only one dusty bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpænəl ðɛr ɪz ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈdʌsti bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 面板？我只看到一顆蒙灰的門鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that bell rings the caretaker flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt bɛl rɪŋz ðə ˈkɛrˌteɪkər flæt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那顆是按給管理員的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Caretaker means the man who sweeps stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrˌteɪkər minz ðə mæn hu swips stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 管理員是指掃樓梯的那位先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press twice and he will answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs prɛs twaɪs ænd hi wɪl ˈænsər/
dialogue.zh: 對，按兩下他就會應門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed twice, I hear a buzz inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛst twaɪs aɪ hɪr ə bʌz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 按了兩下，我聽到一陣嗡嗡聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That buzz unlocks the door, push firmly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bʌz ʌnˈlɑks ðə dɔr pʊʃ ˈfɜrmli/
dialogue.zh: 那聲響就是解鎖，用力把門推開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pushing now, the handle sticks a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ naʊ ðə ˈhændəl stɪks ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我正在推，門把有點卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the handle while you push, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ði ˈhændəl waɪl ju pʊʃ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請把門把抬高一點再推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifted, the door swung open finally.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪd ðə dɔr swʌŋ ˈoʊpən ˈfaɪnəli/
dialogue.zh: 抬起來了，門終於被打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you are in the lobby, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju ɑr ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你現在應該已經在大廳裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, tiles, one bench, mailboxes in rows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ˈtaɪlz wʌn bɛntʃ ˈmeɪlˌbɑksəz ɪn roʊz/
dialogue.zh: 進來了，磁磚、一張長凳，信箱一排排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bench is for visitors waiting, sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛntʃ ɪz fɔr ˈvɪzɪtərz ˈweɪtɪŋ sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 長凳是給等候的人坐，先坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Waiting, but where are you right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪtɪŋ bʌt wɛr ɑr ju raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我坐著等，你現在人在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am upstairs with another viewer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˌʌpˈstɛrz wɪð əˈnʌðər ˈvjuzər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在在樓上，帶另一位看房客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another viewer, so I am not alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðər ˈvjuzər soʊ aɪ æm nɑt əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 還有別的看房者，我不是唯一一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not alone, but your nine thirty slot holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt əˈloʊn bʌt jʊr naɪn ˈθɜrdi slɑt hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 不是唯一，但你九點半那個時段還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine thirty, then who is that upstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈθɜrdi ðɛn hu ɪz ðæt ˌʌpˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 九點半，那樓上是什麼人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A couple with a baby, very calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkʌpəl wɪð ə ˈbeɪbi ˈvɛri kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 一對帶寶寶的夫妻，很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Baby sounds tough for a shared wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪbi saʊndz tʌf fɔr ə ʃɛrd wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 有寶寶的話，共用那面牆有點難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their flat is at the far end though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr flæt ɪz æt ðə fɑr ɛnd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過他們那間在走道最尾端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Far end helps, I sleep with windows open.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr ɛnd hɛlps aɪ slip wɪð ˈwɪndoʊz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 遠一點有幫助，我睡覺都開窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then note the window locks, they are old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ lɑks ðeɪ ɑr oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 那請留意窗戶鎖扣，都是舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elevator or stairs while I wait here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɔr stɛrz waɪl aɪ weɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡等，該搭電梯還是樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait here, I come down in two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt hɪr aɪ kʌm daʊn ɪn tu ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡等，我兩分鐘就下樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, I will watch the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，我幫你看著那扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not open for strangers, that matters.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈoʊpən fɔr ˈstreɪndʒərz ðæt ˈmætərz/
dialogue.zh: 別替陌生人開門，這一點要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, no buzzer for unknown voices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd noʊ ˈbʌzər fɔr ʌnˈnoʊn ˈvɔɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 了解，聽不出來的聲音我不按。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, some people fish for open doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli sʌm ˈpipəl fɪʃ fɔr ˈoʊpən dɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，有人會哄人幫他開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fishing, that is a warning worth keeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪʃɪŋ ðæt ɪz ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ wɜrθ ˈkipɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這種提醒，我會放在心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am down, stand up and wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm daʊn stænd ʌp ænd weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我下樓了，站起來揮個手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing, waving, you have the green coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ ˈweɪvɪŋ ju hæv ðə ɡrin koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我站起來揮手了，你穿那件綠外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, come with me, we take the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kʌm wɪθ mi wi teɪk ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 對，跟著我走，我們爬樓梯上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stairs, so no elevator ride today?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛrz soʊ noʊ ˈɛləˌveɪtər raɪd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 走樓梯，那今天搭不到電梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The elevator needs a card, I forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər nidz ə kɑrd aɪ fərˈɡɑt/
dialogue.zh: 電梯要感應卡，我忘記帶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forgot? Then stairs it is for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /fərˈɡɑt ðɛn stɛrz ɪt ɪz fɔr ʌz/
dialogue.zh: 忘記啊？那我們就爬樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Climb slowly, the steps are worn unevenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /klaɪm ˈsloʊli ðə stɛps ɑr wɔrn ʌnˈivənli/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢爬，階梯磨得不太平整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worn steps, is the handrail solid at least?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrn stɛps ɪz ðə ˈhændˌreɪl ˈsɑlɪd æt list/
dialogue.zh: 階梯舊了，扶手至少還穩吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Solid iron, bolted twice, heavier than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑlɪd ˈaɪərn ˈboʊltəd twaɪs ˈhɛviər ðæn mi/
dialogue.zh: 整條是鐵的，鎖了兩次，很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavier is good, I grab everything twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛviər ɪz ɡʊd aɪ ɡræb ˈɛvriθɪŋ twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 穩固就好，我什麼都要摸兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor landing has a smell, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr ˈlændɪŋ hæz ə smɛl ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 二樓轉角有一點氣味，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell? Cooking smoke or damp in walls?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ˈkʊkɪŋ smoʊk ɔr dæmp ɪn wɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 氣味？是炒菜的煙還是牆壁發潮？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly soup, the walls are dry here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli suːp ðə wɔlz ɑr draɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 主要是湯味，這邊的牆是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry walls matter more than a good smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ wɔlz ˈmætɚ mɔr ðæn ə ɡʊd smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 牆壁乾燥比氣味舒服更重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third floor now, almost at your flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd flɔr naʊ ˈɔlmoʊst æt jʊr flæt/
dialogue.zh: 上到三樓了，快到你要看的那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost, my heart beats faster suddenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst maɪ hɑrt bits ˈfæstər ˈsʌdənli/
dialogue.zh: 快到了，我的心跳突然變快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nervous is normal, most viewers feel it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɜrvəs ɪz ˈnɔrməl moʊst ˈvjuzərz fil ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 緊張很正常，多數看房的人都會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here at door five, the brass number.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr æt dɔr faɪv ðə bræs ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 五號門口，門牌是銅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The key is stiff, give me one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ki ɪz stɪf ɡɪv mi wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙孔有點卡，給我一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No hurry, my list can wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɜri maɪ lɪst kæn weɪt ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我的清單可以等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two turns, and the bolt slides back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɜrnz ænd ðə boʊlt slaɪdz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 轉兩下，門栓就往後退了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It opened, and the hall light is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənd ænd ðə hɔl laɪt ɪz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 開了，而且玄關的燈是亮著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I switched it on before we climbed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ swɪtʃt ɪt ɑn bɪˈfɔr wi klaɪmd/
dialogue.zh: 我上樓之前就把燈開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kind of you, the door shuts so softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd əv ju ðə dɔr ʃʌts soʊ ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 你真體貼，關門幾乎沒有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello Kevin, welcome, step in from the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ ˈkɛvɪn ˈwɛlkəm stɛp ɪn frʌm ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 凱文你好，歡迎，從樓梯進來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, the climb was a real test.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðə klaɪm wʌz ə ril tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，爬樓本身就是一場考驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time I bring the elevator card.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ brɪŋ ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 下次我會把電梯卡帶上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside at last, the hall feels bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd æt læst ðə hɔl filz braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 終於進屋了，玄關感覺很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoes stay on, we will see both rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz steɪ ɑn wi wɪl si boʊθ rumz/
dialogue.zh: 鞋子穿著就好，我們兩間都看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes on is kind, my socks have holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz ɑn ɪz kaɪnd maɪ sɑks hæv hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 不用脫鞋真好，我襪子有破洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no explaining, walk straight to the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ wɔk streɪt tu ðə ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 那就別解釋，直接走到廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen smells of paint, is it new?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən smɛlz ʌv peɪnt ɪz ɪt nu/
dialogue.zh: 廚房有油漆味，是剛刷的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh coat last week, aired twice daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ koʊt læst wik ɛrd twaɪs ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 上週才上一層漆，每天通風兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aired well, my throat feels no sting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛrd wɛl maɪ θroʊt filz noʊ stɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 通風不錯，我喉嚨沒有刺痛感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open this window, the latch works loosely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðɪs ˈwɪndoʊ ðə lætʃ wɜrks ˈlusli/
dialogue.zh: 打開這扇窗，窗扣有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose latch, is that a night problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /lus lætʃ ɪz ðæt ə naɪt ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 窗扣鬆了，晚上會是問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here, third floor, nobody reaches easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪr θɜrd flɔr ˈnoʊbədi ˈritʃəz ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 不會，在三樓，外人攀不上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I still sleep with the latch closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr aɪ stɪl slip wɪð ðə lætʃ kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 也是，我睡覺還是會扣好窗扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart habit, let us start with rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ˈhæbɪt lɛt ʌs stɑrt wɪð rumz/
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，我們先從房間看起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bedroom first, then the bigger one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbɛdˌrum fɜrst ðɛn ðə ˈbɪɡər wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 先看小臥室，再看大的那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bigger one faces the inner courtyard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪɡər wʌn ˈfeɪsəz ði ˈɪnər ˈkɔrtˌjɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 大那間面對中庭內院。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Courtyard view means morning shade, correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrtˌjɑrd vju minz ˈmɔrnɪŋ ʃeɪd kəˈrɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 朝中庭那一面早上沒陽光，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, shade until ten, then bright sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt ʃeɪd ʌnˈtɪl tɛn ðɛn braɪt sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對，十點前有陰影，之後太陽進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten is fine, I leave before eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz faɪn aɪ liv bɪˈfɔr eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十點沒關係，我八點前就出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then daylight hardly matters for your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈdeɪˌlaɪt ˈhɑrdli ˈmætərz fɔr jʊr deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那採光對你的白天影響很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, but weekends live in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt bʌt ˈwikˌɛndz lɪv ɪn ðɪs rum/
dialogue.zh: 可是我的週末都耗在這間房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the corner by the tall window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə ˈkɔrnər baɪ ðə tɔl ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就把窗邊那個角落留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall window, does it open fully outward?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl ˈwɪndoʊ dʌz ɪt ˈoʊpən ˈfʊli ˈaʊtwərd/
dialogue.zh: 那片高窗能整個往外推開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tilts inward for cleaning, clever design.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɪlts ɪnˈwərd fɔr ˈklinkɪŋ ˈklɛvər dɪˈzaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 它會往內傾，方便擦，設計貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleaning saves my neck, I live alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinkɪŋ seɪvz maɪ nɛk aɪ lɪv əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 好擦救了我的脖子，我一個人住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this flat suits you, honestly speaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs flæt suts ju ˈɑnəstli ˈspikɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那這間房子挺適合你，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly is strong, I still need proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ɪz strɔŋ aɪ stɪl nid pruf/
dialogue.zh: 這句話很有力，但我還要證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof comes when we test everything next.
dialogue.phonetic: /pruf kʌmz wɛn wi tɛst ˈɛvriθɪŋ nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 等一下全部試過一遍就有證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before testing, tell me about the bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ˈtɛstɪŋ tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 試之前，先跟我講講費用的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good order, bills confuse every new tenant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈɔrdər bɪlz kənˈfjuz ˈɛvri nu ˈtɛnənt/
dialogue.zh: 順序對了，帳單常讓新房客霧裡看花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, money talk before water talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈmʌni tɔk bɪˈfɔr ˈwɔtər tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，先講錢，再來講水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit at the kitchen table, I have papers.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt æt ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈteɪbəl aɪ hæv ˈpeɪpərz/
dialogue.zh: 坐到廚房桌邊，我帶了文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Papers spread out, this feels official already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərz sprɛd aʊt ðɪs filz əˈfɪʃəl ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 文件攤開，已經有看合約的感覺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Official enough, but nothing is signed yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈfɪʃəl ɪˈnʌf bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz saɪnd jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 夠正式了，但還沒有簽任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No signing yet, just listening with eyes open.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈsaɪnɪŋ jɛt dʒʌst ˈlɪsənɪŋ wɪð aɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 先不簽，我只睜大眼睛聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly the right viewing posture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə raɪt ˈvjuwɪŋ ˈpɔstʃər/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，那就是看房最好的姿勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Posture noted, my bag has one notebook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɔstʃər ˈnoʊtəd maɪ bæɡ hæz wʌn ˈnoʊtˌbʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我記下了，我包裡帶了一本筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it, I will talk numbers now.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt aɪ wɪl tɔk ˈnʌmbərz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 正好，我現在開始報數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers welcome, rent first, then the extras.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbərz ˈwɛlkəm rɛnt fɜrst ðɛn ði ˈɛkstrəz/
dialogue.zh: 數字我愛聽，先租金再雜費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rent stays twelve hundred, remember that base.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛnt steɪz twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 租金就是一千二，先記住這個底數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Base remembered, now what rides on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /beɪs rɪˈmɛmbərd naʊ wʌt raɪdz ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 底數記好了，上面還會加什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top comes from water, heat and waste.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp kʌmz frʌm ˈwɔtər hit ænd weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 上面加的是水費、暖氣和垃圾費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Waste means trash pickup, I think so.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪst minz træʃ ˈpɪkˌʌp aɪ θɪŋk soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我想那指的應該是垃圾清運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twice weekly, the truck comes Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs twaɪs ˈwikli ðə trʌk kʌmz ˈmʌndez/
dialogue.zh: 對，一週兩次，週一垃圾車來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me that paper, the cost sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðæt ˈpeɪpər ðə kɔst ʃit/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩把那張費用單拿給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, rent on top, extras below.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr rɛnt ɑn tɑp ɪkˈstrəz bɪˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，租金排最上面，附加費在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve hundred rent, and water costs how much?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd rɛnt ænd ˈwɔtər kɔsts haʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 租金一千二，那水費要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water averages fifteen, meter read monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ˈævərɪdʒɪz ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmitər rɛd ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 水費平均十五，每一個月抄一次表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen water is honest, my old place was twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ˈwɔtər ɪz ˈɑnɪst maɪ oʊld pleɪs wʌz ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 水費十五算實在，我以前那間要二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old buildings drink more, pipes leak slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈbɪldɪŋz drɪŋk mɔr paɪps lik ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 老房子用水多，管線會慢慢滲漏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaking pipes, will the owner fix those?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlikɪŋ paɪps wɪl ði ˈonər fɪks ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 管線滲漏，業主會處理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big repairs never land on your bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɪɡ rɪˈpɛrz ˈnɛvər lænd ɑn jʊr bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 會，大修那一筆絕不會落到你帳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, electricity then, who reads that meter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti ðɛn hu ridz ðæt ˈmitər/
dialogue.zh: 好，那用電的部分，誰來讀電表？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A man comes the first Tuesday, knocking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn kʌmz ðə fɜrst ˈtuzdeɪ ˈnɑkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 每個月第一個週二，有人會敲門抄表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday means I must be home then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ minz aɪ mʌst bi hoʊm ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 週二就代表那個時間我得在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or leave the meter photo, that works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr liv ðə ˈmitər ˈfoʊtoʊ ðæt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 或者自己把電表拍下來傳過去也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photo of numbers, clever, saves a trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ˈnʌmbərz ˈklɛvər seɪvz ə trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 用照片記數字，聰明，省跑一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it the same evening, no later.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt ðə seɪm ˈivnɪŋ noʊ ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 當天晚上就傳過來，別拖到隔天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same evening works, though I come home late.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈivnɪŋ wɜrks ðoʊ aɪ kʌm hoʊm leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當天晚上傳得來，雖然我回家比較晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late is fine, my inbox stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ɪz faɪn maɪ ˈɪnˌbɑks steɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 晚一點無妨，我的信箱一直開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inbox noted, gas next, is there a tank?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪnˌbɑks ˈnoʊtəd ɡæs nɛkst ɪz ðɛr ə tæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 信箱記下了，接著是瓦斯，有桶裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tank, gas runs from the street pipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tæŋk ɡæs rʌnz frʌm ðə striːt paɪp/
dialogue.zh: 沒有桶裝，瓦斯是從街上管線進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Street pipe means bills from a company.
dialogue.phonetic: /striːt paɪp minz bɪlz frʌm ə ˈkʌmpəni/
dialogue.zh: 管線供氣，就是瓦斯公司直接開帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they bill you direct, not us.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ bɪl ju dəˈrɛkt nɑt ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 對，他們向你收錢，不經過我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Direct billing, then I need a deposit there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dəˈrɛkt ˈbɪlɪŋ ðɛn aɪ nid ə dɪˈpɑzɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 直接收費的話，那邊也要押金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They ask nothing if your name is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æsk ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪf jʊr neɪm ɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 欠款紀錄乾淨，他們什麼都不要求。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean name, good, internet is my own then?
dialogue.phonetic: /klin neɪm ɡʊd ˈɪntərˌnɛt ɪz maɪ on ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 紀錄好就好，那網路我要自己申裝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may keep ours, it costs thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ kip ˈaʊərz ɪz kɔsts ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 你也可以沿用我們的，一個月三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty for shared fiber feels acceptable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti fɔr ʃɛrd ˈfaɪbər filz əkˈsɛptəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 花三十用共享光纖，還能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Acceptable, and no contract year binding you.
dialogue.phonetic: /əkˈsɛptəbəl ænd noʊ kənˈtrækt jɪr ˈbaɪndɪŋ ju/
dialogue.zh: 可以，而且沒有綁一年的合約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No binding year, that frees my choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbaɪndɪŋ jɪr ðæt friːz maɪ tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 沒綁約，我換地方就自由多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cancel anytime, but give two weeks notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænsəl ˈɛniˌtaɪm bʌt ɡɪv tu wikz ˈnoʊtɪs/
dialogue.zh: 隨時能停，不過要提前兩週說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks notice, I can write that.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz ˈnoʊtɪs aɪ kən raɪt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 提前兩週，這件事我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trash fee comes next, seven monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /træʃ fim kʌmz nɛkst ˈsɛvən ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 接著是垃圾費，一個月七塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven trash is cheap, who hauls it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən træʃ ɪz tʃip hu hɔlz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 七塊算便宜，清運是哪家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The building firm, same truck as Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ fɜrm seɪm trʌk æz ˈmʌndez/
dialogue.zh: 大樓配合的那家，就是週一那輛車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mondays, and recycling on which day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌndəz ænd ˌrisaɪˈklɪŋ ɑn wɪtʃ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週一是垃圾，資源回收是哪天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday evenings, the bin goes outside then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈivnɪŋz ðə bɪn ɡoʊz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 週四傍晚，那時候把桶子推到外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday I work late, can a neighbor help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ aɪ wɜrk leɪt kæn ə ˈneɪbər hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 週四我加班，鄰居能幫忙推桶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The caretaker rolls bins for old residents.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɛrˌteɪkər roʊlz bɪnz fɔr oʊld ˈrɛzɪdənts/
dialogue.zh: 管理員會替年長住戶把桶子推下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rolls for the elderly, that is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊlz fɔr ði ɛlˈdɜrli ðæt ɪz kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 會替長輩推，這很體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind, and it teaches the building rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd ænd ɪt ˈtitʃəz ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ rulz/
dialogue.zh: 人也善，順便讓大家記得規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rules bring us to the service fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /rulz brɪŋ ʌs tu ðə ˈsɜrvəs fim/
dialogue.zh: 提到規矩，剛好講管理費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Service fee is sixty, fixed all year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɜrvəs fim ɪz ˈsɪksti fɪkst ɔl jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 管理費六十，一整年都不調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty covers which parts of the building?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti ˈkʌvərz wɪtʃ pɑrts ʌv ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那六十涵蓋大樓哪些區塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hallway lamps, elevator repair, the roof work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɔˌleɪ læmpz ˈɛləˌveɪtər rɪˈpɛr ðə ruf wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 走廊燈、電梯維修，還有屋頂保養。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roof work matters, the top floor always knows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruf wɜrk ˈmætərz ðə tɑp flɔr ˈɔlˌweɪz noʊz/
dialogue.zh: 屋頂保養要緊，頂樓那一層最清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It leaked twice before, now patched fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt likt twaɪs bɪˈfɔr naʊ pætʃt ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 以前漏過兩次，現在整片補好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Patched fully, I will still watch ceilings.
dialogue.phonetic: /pætʃt ˈfʊli aɪ wɪl stɪl wɑtʃ ˈsilɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 補好了，我還是會盯著天花板看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch for brown rings, those tell the truth.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ fɔr braʊn rɪŋz ðoʊz tɛl ðə truθ/
dialogue.zh: 要留意褐色圓圈，那個會說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown rings, got it, next the parking fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn rɪŋz ɡɑt ɪt nɛkst ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ fim/
dialogue.zh: 褐色圓圈記下了，再來是停車費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bike spot costs nothing, cars pay forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪk spɑt kɔsts ˈnʌθɪŋ kɑrz peɪ ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 自行車位免費，汽車位要四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty parked, and the agency fee today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti pɑrkt ænd ði ˈeɪdʒənsi fim təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 汽車四十，那今天的仲介費呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agency takes half of one month rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪdʒənsi teɪks hæf ʌv wʌn mʌnθ rɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 仲介收半個月的房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a month, that is six hundred once.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə mʌnθ ðæt ɪz sɪks ˈhʌndrəd wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 半個月就是六百，而且只付一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, no yearly renewal charge from us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns noʊ ˈjɪrli rɪˈnul tʃɑrdʒ frʌm ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 一次就好，我們不收年度續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No renewal charge, then what is the total?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪˈnul tʃɑrdʒ ðɛn wʌt ɪz ðə ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 沒有續費，那加總一個月是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around fourteen hundred with an average month.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ˌfɔrˈtin ˈhʌndrəd wɪð ən ˈævərɪdʒ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 普通的一個月大約一千四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen hundred sits inside my budget ceiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɔrˈtin ˈhʌndrəd sɪts ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ˈsilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一千四落在我的預算上限裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, budgets break when people guess high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈbʌdʒɪts breɪk wɛn ˈpipəl ɡɛs haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很好，估算抓太高時預算就會爆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess high, yes, my last month blew up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛs haɪ jɛs maɪ læst mʌnθ blu ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我上次就抓太高，整月超支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bills climb when heaters run all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪlz klaɪm wɛn ˈhitərz rʌn ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣整夜運轉時，帳單就往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heaters all night, is that allowed here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhitərz ɔl naɪt ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以讓暖氣開整晚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allowed, but the cost is yours alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd bʌt ðə kɔst ɪz jʊrz əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但那筆錢得你自己扛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a fixed monthly cap exist here?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə fɪkst ˈmʌnθli kæp ɪɡˈzɪst hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有沒有每月上限的方案？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cap, just read your own meter.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kæp dʒʌst rid jʊr on ˈmitər/
dialogue.zh: 沒有上限，只看你自己那顆表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reading my own meter I can learn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈridɪŋ maɪ on ˈmitər aɪ kən lɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 讀自己的水電表，我學得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will mark the dials once for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl mɑrk ðə ˈdaɪəlz wʌns fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 我會先替你把刻度圈起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark the dials, then I copy numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrk ðə ˈdaɪəlz ðɛn aɪ ˈkɑpi ˈnʌmbərz/
dialogue.zh: 圈好刻度，之後我照著抄數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep a pencil note, paper beats memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ə ˈpɛnsəl noʊt ˈpeɪpər bits ˈmɛməri/
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆記，紙比記性可靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper beats memory, I already lost one lease.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər bits ˈmɛməri aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi lɔst wʌn lis/
dialogue.zh: 我上一次就把租約弄丟過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lost lease papers cost real money, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔst lis ˈpeɪpərz kɔst ril ˈmʌni ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 租約文件不見要花錢補，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cost money to replace a single page?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔst ˈmʌni tu rɪˈpleɪs ə ˈsɪŋɡəl peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 補印一頁也要收錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty for a certified copy, official rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fɔr ə ˈsɜrtəˌfaɪd ˈkɑpi əˈfɪʃəl rul/
dialogue.zh: 認證複本二十塊，這是正式規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Official rule, then I keep mine folded.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈfɪʃəl rul ðɛn aɪ kip maɪn ˈfoʊldɪd/
dialogue.zh: 規定如此，那我會把合約收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folder works best, loose pages curl fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldər wɜrks bɛst lus ˈpeɪdʒəz kɜrl fæst/
dialogue.zh: 用資料夾最好，散頁一下就捲邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curl fast, my old bills look like waves.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɜrl fæst maɪ oʊld bɪlz lʊk laɪk weɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 我舊帳單都捲得像海浪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then go paperless, we email every statement.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡoʊ ˈpeɪpərlɪs wi ˈiməl ˈɛvri ˈsteɪtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 那就改電子帳單，明細用寄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paperless sounds tidy, but do I get receipts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərlɪs saʊndz ˈtaɪdi bʌt du aɪ ɡɛt rɪˈsits/
dialogue.zh: 電子帳單純淨，可收據還拿得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipts download with the statement, one click.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsits ˈdaʊnˌloʊd wɪð ðə ˈsteɪtmənt wʌn klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 收據跟明細一起下載，點一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One click, then rent paid by autopay too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɪk ðɛn rɛnt peɪd baɪ ˈɔtoʊˌpeɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那租金也能用自動繳款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Autopay on the third, bank handles it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔtoʊˌpeɪ ɑn ðə θɜrd bæŋk ˈhændəlz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 自動繳設在每月三號，銀行處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The third, and late payment brings a fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɜrd ænd leɪt ˈpeɪmənt brɪŋz ə fim/
dialogue.zh: 三號扣款，那遲繳會有罰金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five percent after seven days, nothing before.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv pɜrˈsɛnt ˈæftər ˈsɛvən deɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 逾期七天開始加百分之五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven days grace is generous, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən deɪz ɡres ɪz ˈdʒɛnərəs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 有七天緩繳，算寬容了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set an alarm, that grace is not habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ə əˈlɑrm ðæt ɡres ɪz nɑt ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 設個鬧鐘，別把寬限當成長習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alarm set, now splitting bills with roommates?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɑrm sɛt naʊ ˈsplɪtɪŋ bɪlz wɪð ˈrumˌmeɪts/
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘設好了，那跟室友怎麼拆帳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bedrooms, so the bill divides by two.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɛdˌrumz soʊ ðə bɪl dɪˈvaɪdz baɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 兩間臥室，帳單就對半拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Divided evenly feels fair to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈvaɪdəd ˈivənli filz fɛr tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 平均拆帳我覺得最公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even split only works when both use heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən splɪt ˈoʊnli wɜrks wɛn boʊθ juz hit/
dialogue.zh: 前提是兩個人都會開暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both use heat, so my list has questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ juz hit soʊ maɪ lɪst hæz ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 兩人都會用暖氣，那我問題更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask all now, before we test the taps.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɔl naʊ bɪˈfɔr wi tɛst ðə tæps/
dialogue.zh: 現在一次問完，再來試水龍頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taps wait a minute, who pays broken pipes?
dialogue.phonetic: /tæps weɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt hu peɪz ˈbroʊkən paɪps/
dialogue.zh: 水龍頭先等一下，管線壞了誰付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pipes are his, small blockages are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /paɪps ɑr hɪz smɔl ˈblɑkɪdʒəz ɑr jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 管線算他的，小阻塞算你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hair blockages mean a strainer, I buy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr ˈblɑkɪdʒəz min ə ˈstrenər aɪ baɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 頭髮會堵住，所以我買個濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy the cheap mesh, eight in hardware.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə tʃip mɛʃ eɪt ɪn ˈhɑrdˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 買便宜那款濾網，五金行八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hardware store, then a light bulb too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdˌwɛr stor ðɛn ə laɪt bʌlb tu/
dialogue.zh: 五金行，那燈泡也自己添？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bulbs are yours, lamps are the owner's.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌlbz ɑr jʊrz læmpz ɑr ði ˈonərz/
dialogue.zh: 燈泡歸你們，燈具歸業主。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear enough, the total still looks workable.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ɪˈnʌf ðə ˈtoʊtəl stɪl lʊks ˈwɜrkəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 夠清楚了，總額看起來還能負擔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Workable rent beats a cheap scary flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrkəbəl rɛnt bits ə tʃip ˈskɛri flæt/
dialogue.zh: 付得起的租金，勝過便宜可怕的房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scary cheap flats hide water damage, surely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskɛri tʃip flæts haɪd ˈwɔtər ˈdæmɪdʒ ˈʃʊrli/
dialogue.zh: 太便宜的房子一定藏著有水損。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly why we open every tap today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli waɪ wi ˈoʊpən ˈɛvri tæp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以今天每個龍頭都要轉開看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us test, my pen is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs tɛst maɪ pɛn ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 那我們開始試，我的筆準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow me to the bathroom, watch the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ mi tu ðə ˈbæθˌrum wɑtʃ ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 跟我到浴室，走路留意地面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me turn the tub tap, may I?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tɜrn ðə tʌb tæp meɪ aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我來轉開浴缸的水龍頭，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, both handles turn easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd boʊθ ˈhændəlz tɜrn ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 轉吧，冷熱兩個把手都很好動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water comes, but is this hot enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər kʌmz bʌt ɪz ðɪs hɑt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 水出來了，但這夠不夠熱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it thirty seconds, the boiler is far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ˈθɜrti ˈsɛkəndz ðə ˈbɔɪlər ɪz fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 等三十秒就好，鍋爐位置離得遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Far boiler means a cold start every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr ˈbɔɪlər minz ə koʊld stɑrt ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鍋爐遠，代表每天早上先流冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run it while you brush your teeth, fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn ɪt waɪl ju brʌʃ jʊr θiθ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 刷牙時先讓它流，就剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty seconds, I can wait that long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈsɛkəndz aɪ kən weɪt ðæt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 三十秒而已，我等得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now feel the pressure with your palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ fil ðə ˈprɛʃər wɪð jʊr pɑm/
dialogue.zh: 現在用你的手掌感受一下水壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressure feels firm, not that thin trickle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɛʃər filz fɜrm nɑt ðæt θɪn ˈtrɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 水壓結實，不是細細的那種水流。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm here, because the tank sits upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm hɪr bɪˈkɔz ðə tæŋk sɪts ˌʌpˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 這裡強，因為水塔就安在樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A water tank upstairs, who cleans it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwɔtər tæŋk ˌʌpˈstɛrz hu klinz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 樓上有水塔，誰負責清洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every spring, the firm drains and scrubs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri sprɪŋ ðə fɜrm dreɪnz ænd skrʌbz/
dialogue.zh: 每年春天，清潔公司會放水洗刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spring cleaning, then my shower is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ ˈklinkɪŋ ðɛn maɪ ˈʃaʊər ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 春天清過，那我的淋浴算乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the shower head, turn it fully on.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈʃaʊər hɛd tɜrn ɪt ˈfʊli ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 試試那顆蓮蓬頭，全部轉開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On now, the spray hits my hand hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn naʊ ðə spreɪ hɪts maɪ hænd hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 開了，水柱打在手上有點疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good spray, the head is new, last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd spreɪ ðə hɛd ɪz nju læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 水花漂亮，蓮蓬頭上個月才換新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New head, and the drain, does it hold water?
dialogue.phonetic: /nu hɛd ænd ðə dreɪn dʌz ɪt hoʊld ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 新的蓮蓬頭，那排水孔會積水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the tub, it empties in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə tʌb ɪt ˈɛmptaɪz ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你看浴缸，一分鐘就排空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emptying fast, that was my old flat fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪmˈptiɪŋ fæst ðæt wʌz maɪ oʊld flæt fɪr/
dialogue.zh: 排得很快，我以前那間就怕這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow drains mean hair, we snake them yearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ dreɪnz min hɛr wi sneɪk ðɛm ˈjɪrli/
dialogue.zh: 排水慢就是頭髮塞住，我們每年通管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snake the pipes yearly, nice to hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /sneɪk ðə paɪps ˈjɪrli naɪs tu hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 每年通一次管線，聽了安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toilet next, flush it, check the seal base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɔɪlət nɛkst flʌʃ ɪt tʃɛk ðə sil beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 再來是馬桶，沖一下看底座密封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flushing now, one handle, strong pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflʌʃɪŋ naʊ wʌn ˈhændəl strɔŋ pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 正在沖水，單把設計，力量很足。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong pull means the cistern fills fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ pʊl minz ðə ˈsɪstərn fɪlz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 沖力強，表示水箱補水也快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cistern is inside the wall, hidden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪstərn ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə wɔl ˈhɪdən/
dialogue.zh: 水箱藏在牆壁裡面，看不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hidden, so repairs use a small service panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪdən soʊ rɪˈpɛrz juz ə smɔl ˈsɜrvəs ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 因為藏起來，維修只開一小片檢修板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Service panel, good, no smashed tile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɜrvəs ˈpænəl ɡʊd noʊ smæʃt taɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有檢修板就好，不用砸磁磚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tile work, the wall stays intact.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ taɪl wɜrk ðə wɔl steɪz ɪnˈtækt/
dialogue.zh: 不碰磁磚，那面牆保持完整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen tap next, does it swing around?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən tæp nɛkst dʌz ɪt swɪŋ əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 接著廚房龍頭，它能左右轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It swings, though the joint feels stiff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt swɪŋz ðoʊ ðə dʒɔɪnt filz stɪf/
dialogue.zh: 會轉，不過接頭有點生硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stiff joint, will it loosen with use?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪf dʒɔɪnt wɪl ɪt ˈlusən wɪθ juz/
dialogue.zh: 接頭硬，多用幾次會變鬆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It loosens, or I oil it in a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈlusənz ɔr aɪ ɔɪl ɪt ɪn ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 會自己變軟，不然我下週上點油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kind, but who may enter later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd bʌt hu meɪ ˈɛntər ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 那很好，可我搬進來之後誰能進門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only me, and your keys stay with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli mi ænd jʊr kiz steɪ wɪθ ju/
dialogue.zh: 只有我可以，你的鑰匙也得自己收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keys stay with me, understood fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz steɪ wɪθ mi ˌʊndərˈstʊd ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙我自己收好，這點明白了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never copy them for a friend, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ˈkɑpi ðɛm fɔr ə frɛnd pliz/
dialogue.zh: 千萬別替朋友複製門匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No copies, how about a spare set then?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkɑpiz haʊ əˈbaʊt ə spɛr sɛt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不複製，那備用鑰匙怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner keeps one, locked in a drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈonər kips wʌn lɑkt ɪn ə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 業主留一把，鎖在抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One key with the owner, that is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ki wɪð ði ˈonər ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 房東留一把，這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normal, and he calls before using it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrməl ænd hi kɔlz bɪˈfɔr ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且他使用前會先電話說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calling before entering, I like that rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔlɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ˈɛntərɪŋ aɪ laɪk ðæt rul/
dialogue.zh: 進屋前先打電話，我喜歡這規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it into the contract, as a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ˈɪntu ðə kənˈtrækt æz ə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我會把這一句寫進合約裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the radiator, this thing by the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈreɪdieɪtər ðɪs θɪŋ baɪ ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 現在來看暖氣片，床邊這一座？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hot water panel, heats that room fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɑt ˈwɔtər ˈpænəl hits ðæt rum fæst/
dialogue.zh: 對，熱水式的，暖這間很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heats fast, good, when does it switch on?
dialogue.phonetic: /hits fæst ɡʊd wɛn dʌz ɪt swɪtʃ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 熱得快就好，它幾點啟動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The timer wakes it at six in winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈtaɪmər weɪks ɪt æt sɪks ɪn ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 計時器在冬天的六點把它叫醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six means warm rooms when I wake up.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks minz wɔrm rumz wɛn aɪ weɪk ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 六點啟動，我起床時房間是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm floor too, the pipes run under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm flɔr tu ðə paɪps rʌn ˈʌndər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 地板也溫，管線從下面走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Underfloor pipes, that explains dry socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndərˌflɔr paɪps ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz draɪ sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 地板下的管線，難怪襪子都是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry socks matter when October rain comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ sɑks ˈmætɚ wɛn ɑkˈtoʊbər reɪn kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 十月雨季一來，乾襪子就變重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: October sounds far, but heat bills worry me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbər saʊndz fɑr bʌt hit bɪlz ˈwɜri mi/
dialogue.zh: 十月聽著還遠，但暖氣費讓我不安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat costs one twenty in the coldest month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit kɔsts wʌn ˈtwɛnti ɪn ðə ˈkoʊldəst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 最冷那一個月，暖氣大約一百二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One twenty winter, that is acceptable really.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtwɛnti ˈwɪntər ðæt ɪz əkˈsɛptəbəl ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 冬天一百二，老實說還能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Acceptable, and the windows stop the draft.
dialogue.phonetic: /əkˈsɛptəbəl ænd ðə ˈwɪndoʊz stɑp ðə dræft/
dialogue.zh: 而且窗戶擋得住外面的冷風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Draft, yes, my last flat had cold seams.
dialogue.phonetic: /dræft jɛs maɪ læst flæt hæd koʊld simz/
dialogue.zh: 冷風對，我上一間的窗縫都在漏風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These seams are sealed twice, double glazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz simz ɑr silzd twaɪs ˈdʌbəl ˈɡleɪzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這一間縫封了兩次，還是雙層玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Double glazing cuts the street sound too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌbəl ˈɡleɪzɪŋ kʌts ðə striːt saʊnd tu/
dialogue.zh: 雙層玻璃也把街上的聲音切掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet inside, even when buses pass by.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪnˈsaɪd ˈivən wɛn ˈbʌsəz pæs baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 屋裡安靜，公車經過也聽不太到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the noise solved, what about damp?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə nɔɪz sɑːlvd wʌt əˈbaʊt dæmp/
dialogue.zh: 噪音也解決了，那潮濕發黴呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the corner above the bathtub line.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈkɔrnər əˈbʌv ðə ˈbæθtʌb laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 檢查浴缸上緣那一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That corner shows a faint yellow patch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkɔrnər ʃoʊz ə feɪnt ˈjɛloʊ pætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那個角落有一點淡黃的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old patch, dry now, no smell, no soft paint.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld pætʃ draɪ naʊ noʊ smɛl noʊ sɔft peɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 舊痕跡，現在乾了，沒味道，漆也不軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry patch, I will still watch it weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ pætʃ aɪ wɪl stɪl wɑtʃ ɪt ˈwikli/
dialogue.zh: 乾了，我還是會每星期盯一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch it, and run the fan during showers.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ɪt ænd rʌn ðə fæn ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈʃaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 盯著它，洗澡時順便開抽風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan is loud, but it pulls steam out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn ɪz laʊd bʌt ɪt pʊlz stim aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 風扇很吵，但能把蒸氣抽出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam left inside becomes mold on glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim lɛft ɪnˈsaɪd bɪˈkʌz moʊld ɑn ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣留在屋裡，玻璃上就會長黴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mold on glass, no thank you, fan on.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊld ɑn ɡlæs noʊ θæŋk ju fæn ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 玻璃長黴可不行，風扇我開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit, mold is the tenant's fight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈhæbɪt moʊld ɪz ðə ˈtɛnənts faɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，防黴是房客自己要做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tenant's fight means my cleaning Sunday.
