dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛnənts faɪt minz maɪ ˈklinkɪŋ ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那代表我的週日打掃清單又多一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday bathroom, plus one wipe of seals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈbæθˌrum plʌs wʌn waɪp ʌv silz/
dialogue.zh: 週日清浴室，另外再擦一遍窗縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wiping seals is small, towels are bigger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪpɪŋ silz ɪz smɔl ˈtaʊəlz ɑr ˈbɪɡər/
dialogue.zh: 擦窗縫是小事，毛巾才是大問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towels dry on the rail here, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəlz draɪ ɑn ðə reɪl hɪr si/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾就在這一桿上晾，看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A heated rail, clever, that dries fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhitɪd reɪl ˈklɛvər ðæt draɪz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 會發熱的毛巾桿，真聰明，乾得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast drying stops the damp towel smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst ˈdraɪɪŋ stɑps ðə dæmp ˈtaʊəl smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 乾得快就不會有濕毛巾的怪味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No damp towel smell, that sold me partly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dæmp ˈtaʊəl smɛl ðæt soʊld mi ˈpɑrtli/
dialogue.zh: 沒有濕毛巾味，這一點說服我一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Partly sold, now the radiator in bedroom two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrtli soʊld naʊ ðə ˈreɪdieɪtər ɪn ˈbɛdˌrum tu/
dialogue.zh: 才一半，接著看第二間的暖氣片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bedroom two feels colder, is it broken?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛdˌrum tu filz ˈkoʊldər ɪz ɪt ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 第二間摸起來比較冷，壞了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs air bleeding, ten minutes work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nidz ɛr ˈblidɪŋ tɛn ˈmɪnɪts wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 它需要排氣，十分鐘就能弄好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bleeding a radiator, do I do that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblidɪŋ ə ˈreɪdieɪtər du aɪ du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 幫暖氣片排氣，是我自己來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do it today, and show you how.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɪt təˈdeɪ ænd ʃoʊ ju haʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今天我來做，順便示範給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Showing how helps, I like a manual task.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊɪŋ haʊ hɛlps aɪ laɪk ə ˈmænjuəl tæsk/
dialogue.zh: 有示範最好，我喜歡動手的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Manual tasks keep the flat warm cheaply.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmænjuəl tæsks kip ðə flæt wɔrm ˈtʃipli/
dialogue.zh: 自己會做，屋子暖得又省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaply warm, and if the boiler dies in snow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipli wɔrm ænd ɪf ðə ˈbɔɪlər daɪz ɪn snoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 暖得省錢，那下雪時鍋爐壞了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A man comes within hours, day or night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn kʌmz wɪˈðɪn ˈaʊərz deɪ ɔr naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 師傅幾小時內就到，白天晚上都算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Within hours is a promise in writing?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðɪn ˈaʊərz ɪz ə ˈprɑmɪs ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 幾小時內到場，會寫成白紙黑字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clause eight, it names the repair service.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔz eɪt ɪt neɪmz ðə rɪˈpɛr ˈsɜrvəs/
dialogue.zh: 第八條，上面寫著維修公司名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clause eight, I will read it twice tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔz eɪt aɪ wɪl rid ɪt twaɪs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 第八條，今晚我要讀兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, then tell me your true answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt ðɛn tɛl mi jʊr tru ˈænsər/
dialogue.zh: 讀完再告訴我你真正的答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My answer needs the small bedroom once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈænsər nidz ðə smɔl ˈbɛdˌrum wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我的答案還差一點，就是小臥室那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The colder one? It cools fast in January.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkoʊldər wʌn ɪt kuls fæst ɪn ˌdʒænjuˈɛri/
dialogue.zh: 那間比較冷的嗎？一月冷得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It cools fast, can I add a heater?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kuls fæst kæn aɪ æd ə ˈhitər/
dialogue.zh: 冷得快，我可以自己再加一台暖氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small fan heater works, keep it clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl fæn ˈhitər wɜrks kip ɪt klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 小電暖器管用，四周要保持空曠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it clear, so no drying clothes on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt klɪr soʊ noʊ ˈdraɪɪŋ kloʊðz ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 四周保持空曠，所以不能烘衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, that starts fires, banned in this building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ðæt stɑrts ˈfaɪərz bænd ɪn ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 絕對不行，那會引起火災，大樓禁止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Banned drying, so the heated rail again.
dialogue.phonetic: /bænd ˈdraɪɪŋ soʊ ðə ˈhitɪd reɪl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 禁止烘衣，那就靠那根熱桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rail for towels, airer for shirts, both fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪl fɔr ˈtaʊəlz ˈɛrər fɔr ʃɜrts boʊθ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 熱桿晾毛巾，晾衣架掛襯衫，都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Airer folded in the closet, is it there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛrər ˈfoʊldəd ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt ɪz ɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 折起來的晾衣架，收在衣櫃裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, behind the door, with spare wooden pegs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr wɪð spɛr ˈwʊdən pɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 有，在門片後面，還有備用木夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pegs and rails, my laundry life survives.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛɡz ænd reɪlz maɪ ˈlɔndri laɪf sərˈvaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 有木夾有桿子，我的洗衣日子能過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laundry solved, next you will ask about housemates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔndri sɑːlvd nɛkst ju wɪl æsk əˈbaʊt ˈhaʊsˌmeɪts/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣搞定，接下來你該問室友的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who lives in the other bedroom now?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu lɪvz ɪn ði ˈʌðər ˈbɛdˌrum naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在另一間臥室住的是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One nurse, Nina, she works night shifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn nɜrs ˈninə ʃi wɜrks naɪt ʃɪfts/
dialogue.zh: 一位護士妮娜，她上夜間輪班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night shifts mean she sleeps in daytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ʃɪfts min ʃi slips ɪn ˈdeɪˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 上夜班就代表她要白天睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so keep the hallway quiet by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ kip ðə ˈhɔˌleɪ ˈkwaɪət baɪ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，所以九點後走道要放輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is early for me, I come home late.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz ˈɜrli fɔr mi aɪ kʌm hoʊm leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 九點對我算早，我常常很晚回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft steps are fine, it is noise we ban.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft stɛps ɑr faɪn ɪt ɪz nɔɪz wi bæn/
dialogue.zh: 腳步輕一點就好，我們禁的是噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noise banned, what about phone calls inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɔɪz bænd wʌt əˈbaʊt foʊn kɔlz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 禁止噪音，那在屋裡講電話呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calls in your own room, door closed, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔlz ɪn jʊr on rum dɔr kloʊzd θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 在自己房間講，門關起來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed door, good, does she cook loudly?
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd dɔr ɡʊd dʊz ʃi kʊk ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 關門就好，她煮飯會不會很吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She cooks at dawn, quiet, no radio.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kʊks æt dɔn ˈkwaɪət noʊ ˈreɪdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她都天亮時煮飯，安靜，也不開收音機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dawn cooking, does the smell travel far?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔn ˈkʊkɪŋ dʌz ðə smɛl ˈtrævəl fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 天亮煮飯，味道會飄很遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan pulls most, a little reaches yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn pʊlz moʊst ə ˈlɪtəl ˈritʃəz jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 抽風扇吸掉大半，只剩一點飄過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little garlic is acceptable to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɡɑrlɪk ɪz əkˈsɛptəbəl tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 一點蒜味，我還可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she makes soup, not frying things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃi meɪks suːp nɑt ˈfraɪɪŋ θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 那好，她煮湯，不太油炸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup smells are kinder than fried onions.
dialogue.phonetic: /suːp smɛlz ɑr ˈkaɪndər ðæn fraɪd ˈʌnjənz/
dialogue.zh: 湯味比炸洋蔥溫柔多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina agrees, onions are her own enemy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈninə əˈɡriz ˈʌnjənz ɑr hɜr oʊn ˈɛnəmi/
dialogue.zh: 妮娜也承認，洋蔥是她的敵人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shared spaces, how do you split the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛrd ˈspeɪsəz haʊ du ju splɪt ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 共用的部分，冰箱怎麼分層？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two shelves each, freezer bottom, one label.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃɛlvz itʃ ˈfrizər ˈbɑtəm wʌn ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 每人兩層，冷凍在最低，名字要貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Labels stop the fridge wars, smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəlz stɑp ðə frɪdʒ wɔrz smɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 貼標籤能擋住冰箱之爭，聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wars happened once, now rules are printed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrz ˈhæpənd wʌns naʊ rulz ɑr ˈprɪntɪd/
dialogue.zh: 之前吵過一次，現在規矩都印好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Printed rules, where do I read them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪntɪd rulz wɛr du aɪ rid ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 印出來的規矩，我可以在哪裡讀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fridge door, one small printed card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɪdʒ dɔr wʌn smɔl ˈprɪntɪd kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 就貼在冰箱門上，一張小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleaning rota, is that card also it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinkɪŋ ˈroʊtə ɪz ðæt kɑrd ˈɔlsoʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 打掃輪值，也是同一張卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same card, you scrub the bath one week.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm kɑrd ju skrʌb ðə bæθ wʌn wik/
dialogue.zh: 同一張，輪到你那週就刷浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrubbing baths each month is fair enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskrʌbɪŋ bæθs itʃ mʌnθ ɪz fɛr ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 每個月輪一次浴室，算公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, and Nina never skips her turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ænd ˈninə ˈnɛvər skɪps hɜr tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 公平，妮娜也從不脫輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never skipping turns, that is a relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ˈskɪpɪŋ tɜrnz ðæt ɪz ə rɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 沒有人脫輪，這讓我省心很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relief matters, shared homes fail on chores.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlif ˈmætərz ʃɛrd hoʊmz feɪl ɑn tʃɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 省心很要緊，合租常壞在家務上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chores and money, what about overnight guests?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɔrz ænd ˈmʌni wʌt əˈbaʊt ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 家務講完了，那留宿的客人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two nights maximum, tell Nina first.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naɪts ˈmæksəməz tɛl ˈninə fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 最多兩晚，而且要先告知妮娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two nights, and a partner sleeping over?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naɪts ænd ə ˈpɑrtnər ˈslipɪŋ ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 兩晚，那伴侶過夜也算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same two nights, it counts together, fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm tu naɪts ɪt kaʊnts təˈɡɛðər fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 同樣兩晚，要合併計算才公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting together avoids endless weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ təˈɡɛðər əˈvɔɪdz ˈɛndləs ˈwikˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 合併計算，就不會整週都留人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, some housemates forget others exist.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt sʌm ˈhaʊsˌmeɪts fərˈɡɛt ˈʌðərz ɪɡˈzɪst/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，有些室友會忘記還有別人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forget others, yes, that was my last flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /fərˈɡɛt ˈʌðərz jɛs ðæt wʌz maɪ læst flæt/
dialogue.zh: 忘了別人，對，我上一間就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did it end, that noisy arrangement?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ɪt ɛnd ðæt ˈnɔɪzi əˈreɪndʒmənt/
dialogue.zh: 那段吵鬧的合租後來怎麼收場？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I moved out early, paid one month fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ muvd aʊt ˈɜrli peɪd wʌn mʌnθ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我提早搬走，還罰了一個月錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fine is why I write rules plainly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt faɪn ɪz waɪ aɪ raɪt rulz ˈpleɪnli/
dialogue.zh: 所以我才把規矩寫得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain rules save money, I agree fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn rulz seɪv ˈmʌni aɪ əˈɡri ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 規則明白就省錢，我完全同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the hardest part, animals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ðə ˈhɑrdəst pɑrt ˈænɪməlz/
dialogue.zh: 好，接著是最難的一段，動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Animals, yes, my cat waits at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænɪməlz jɛs maɪ kæt weɪts æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 動物對，我的貓還在舊家等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner allows cats, one per flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈonər əˈlaʊz kæts wʌn pɜr flæt/
dialogue.zh: 業主準許養貓，一戶限一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cat, is that written somewhere formal?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kæt ɪz ðæt ˈrɪtən ˈsɔmwɛr ˈfɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 一隻貓，這有寫在正式文件上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page four, signed by the owner himself.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ fɔr saɪnd baɪ ði ˈonər hɪmˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 在第四頁，業主親自簽過名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed proof matters, what about a pet fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd pruf ˈmætərz wʌt əˈbaʊt ə pɛt fi/
dialogue.zh: 有簽名就可靠，那養寵要另外收費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pet deposit, one month, refunded later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɛt dɪˈpɑzɪt wʌn mʌnθ rɪˈfʌndəd ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 養寵押金收一個月，之後會退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refunded later, if the cat leaves no marks?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈfʌndəd ˈleɪtər ɪf ðə kæt livz noʊ mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 之後會退，前提是貓不留下痕跡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No scratches on doors, no smell in carpet.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈskrætʃəz ɑn dɔrz noʊ smɛl ɪn ˈkɑrpɪt/
dialogue.zh: 門上不能有抓痕，地毯不能有味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cat sleeps on a mat, not carpet.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kæt slips ɑn ə mæt nɑt ˈkɑrpɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的貓都睡墊子，不睡地毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your own mat, then all stays clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jʊr on mæt ðɛn ɔl steɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 自帶墊子就好，那樣全屋都乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean mats, and litter boxes where?
dialogue.phonetic: /klin mæts ænd ˈlɪtər ˈbɑksɪz wɛr/
dialogue.zh: 墊子乾淨，那貓砂盆擺哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bathroom corner, near the exhaust fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæθˌrum ˈkɔrnər nɪr ði ɪkˈskɔst fæn/
dialogue.zh: 浴室那個角落，靠近抽風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan clears litter smells quickly, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn klɪrz ˈlɪtər smɛlz ˈkwɪkli jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 抽風扇很快就把貓砂味帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly why the owner allows cats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli waɪ ði ˈonər əˈlaʊz kæts/
dialogue.zh: 這就是業主準許養貓的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nina, does she mind a cat in shared rooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈninə dʊz ʃi maɪnd ə kæt ɪn ʃɛrd rumz/
dialogue.zh: 妮娜介意貓進到共用空間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is allergic, so doors stay closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˌælərˈdʒɪk soʊ dɔrz steɪ kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 她對貓過敏，所以門要隨時關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Allergy changes my habits a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈælərdʒi ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz maɪ ˈhæbɪts ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 因為過敏，我的習慣要多改不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash hands after feeding, that is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ hændz ˈæftər ˈfidɪŋ ðæt ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 餵完貓就洗手，這樣已經夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand washing, I can build that habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd ˈwɑʃɪŋ aɪ kən bɪld ðæt ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 洗手這件事，我養得成習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Habits form fast in a shared home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæbɪts fɔrm fæst ɪn ə ʃɛrd hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 在合租的屋裡，習慣很快就成形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about dogs, are they banned here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt dɔɡz ɑr ðeɪ bænd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那狗呢，這一棟禁止養狗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dogs need the owner, he says no often.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔɡz nid ði ˈonər hi sɛz noʊ ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 養狗要業主點頭，他多半說不。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No dogs, my cat is lucky then.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dɔɡz maɪ kæt ɪz ˈlʌki ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不讓養狗，那我的貓算幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky, small pets like hamsters are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki smɔl pɛts laɪk ˈhæmstərz ɑr faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 算幸運，倉鼠這類小寵物可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hamsters need almost nothing, good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæmstərz nid ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 倉鼠幾乎不佔什麼空間，挺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish too, one tank, no bigger than twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ tu wʌn tæŋk noʊ ˈbɪɡər ðæn twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 魚也可以，一個缸，不超過十二吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve inches, that fits the shelf bracket.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈɪntʃəz ðæt fɪts ðə ʃɛlf ˈbrækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十二吋剛好放得進那層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brackets hold fifty, ask before drilling though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbrækɪts hoʊld ˈfɪfti æsk bɪˈfɔr ˈdrɪlɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 層架承重五十，但要鑽孔得先問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drilling holes is forbidden, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdrɪlɪŋ hoʊlz ɪz fərˈbɪdən raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鑽牆孔是禁止的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forbidden, patching costs more than the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /fərˈbɪdən ˈpætʃɪŋ kɔsts mɔr ðæn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 禁止的，補洞比一個架子更貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then adhesive hooks, those are allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ædˈhɪsɪv hʊks ðoʊz ɑr əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那無痕掛鉤這種可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hooks stay legal, peel clean when you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʊks steɪ ˈliɡəl pil klin wɛn ju liv/
dialogue.zh: 掛鉤允許，搬走時整片撕下來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving walls clean is my promise here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ wɔlz klin ɪz maɪ ˈprɑmɪs hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 離開時牆面乾淨，是我的承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Promises written down are stronger ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑmɪsəz ˈrɪtən daʊn ɑr ˈstrɔŋɡər wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 白紙黑字的承諾才更有力量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Written, yes, put that in my file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtən jɛs pʊt ðæt ɪn maɪ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 寫下來，對，把這句放進我的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smoking is next, are you a smoker?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmoʊkɪŋ ɪz nɛkst ɑr ju ə ˈsmoʊkər/
dialogue.zh: 接著是抽菸，你抽菸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I quit, not even on the balcony.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ kwɪt nɑt ˈivən ɑn ðə ˈbælkəni/
dialogue.zh: 我不抽了，連在陽台都不抽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the balcony is smoke free here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə ˈbælkəni ɪz smoʊk fri hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 很好，這一棟的陽台也是無菸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smoke free balcony, what about plants?
dialogue.phonetic: /smoʊk fri ˈbælkəni wʌt əˈbaʊt plænts/
dialogue.zh: 無菸的陽台，那種植物呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plants welcome, but no hanging pots outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænts ˈwɛlkəm bʌt noʊ ˈhæŋɪŋ pɑts ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 植物歡迎，但外面不能吊盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hanging pots, a wind risk, I see that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæŋɪŋ pɑts ə wɪnd rɪsk aɪ si ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 吊盆會被風吹落，我懂這個風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fell last summer, it landed on cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɛl læst ˈsʌmər ɪt ˈlændəd ɑn kɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 去年夏天掉過一個，砸到下面的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Landed on cars, that ends any balcony garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlændəd ɑn kɑrz ðæt ɛndz ˈɛni ˈbælkəni ˈɡɑrdən/
dialogue.zh: 砸到車，那陽台園藝就別想了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pots on the floor, still green, still safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑts ɑn ðə flɔr stɪl ɡrin stɪl seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 花盆擺在地上，一樣綠，一樣安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Floor pots, then shoes inside, or outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /flɔr pɑts ðɛn ʃuz ɪnˈsaɪd ɔr ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 花盆落地，那鞋子穿進屋還是脫門外？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoes off at the door, that is custom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz ɔf æt ðə dɔr ðæt ɪz ˈkʌstəm/
dialogue.zh: 進門就脫鞋，這是這裡的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Custom I keep anyway, my rug collects dirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌstəm aɪ kip ˈɛniˌweɪ maɪ rʌɡ kəˈlɛkts dɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 我本來就會脫，我那塊地毯最會卡灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slippers are provided, two pairs per flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpərz ɑr prəˈvaɪdɪd tu pɛrz pɜr flæt/
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋是附的，一戶給兩雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pairs, one for me, one for guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz wʌn fɔr mi wʌn fɔr ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 兩雙，一雙我自己，一雙給客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guest slippers live in the entrance basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛst ˈslɪpərz lɪv ɪn ði ˈɛntrəns ˈbæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 客人的拖鞋放在玄關那個籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Basket, tidy system, who taught all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæskɪt ˈtaɪdi ˈsɪstəm hu tɔt ɔl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 用籃子收納，真整齊，誰教的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner, he lived in a shared flat once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈonər hi ˈlɪvd ɪn ə ʃɛrd flæt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 是業主，他以前也合租過一陣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Living shared teaches you the noise quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪvɪŋ ʃɛrd ˈtitʃəz ju ðə nɔɪz ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 合租過的人，很快就會懂得噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He knows, so rules are fair, not strict.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi noʊz soʊ rulz ɑr fɛr nɑt strɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 他懂，所以規矩公平而不苛刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair not strict, that is my kind of house.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr nɑt strɪkt ðæt ɪz maɪ kaɪnd ʌv haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 公平但不苛責，正是我想要的那種家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina will meet you tonight, are you free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈninə wɪl mit ju təˈnaɪt ɑr ju fri/
dialogue.zh: 妮娜想今晚見你一面，你有空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight? Yes, meeting her feels right.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt jɛs ˈmitɪŋ hɜr filz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚？好，先見她一面是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven in the kitchen, tea is offered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ti ɪz ˈɔfərd/
dialogue.zh: 七點在廚房，她會泡一壺茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea and a housemate, a good trial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ænd ə ˈhaʊsˌmeɪt ə ɡʊd ˈtraɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 一壺茶加一位室友，是場好試用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trial goes well, then we speak of deposit papers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtraɪəl ɡoʊz wɛl ðɛn wi spik ʌv dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈpeɪpərz/
dialogue.zh: 相處沒問題的話，接著就談押金文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deposit first, two months of twelve hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈpɑzɪt fɜrst tu mʌnθs ʌv twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 先談押金，兩個月的一千二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is right, twenty four hundred total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz raɪt ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈhʌndrəd ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，押金總共兩千四百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty four hundred leaves me nervous today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈhʌndrəd livz mi ˈnɜrvəs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一次拿出兩千四百，我今天有點緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nervous is fair, it is your own money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɜrvəs ɪz fɛr ɪt ɪz jʊr on ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 緊張很合理，那是你自己的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my money sit in a real account?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ ˈmʌni sɪt ɪn ə ril əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我的押金會放在真正的帳戶裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a protected account, separate from ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə prəˈtɛktɪd əˈkaʊnt ˈsɛpərət frʌm ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 會，專設的保護帳戶，跟我們的分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Separate account, then I cannot touch it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛpərət əˈkaʊnt ðɛn aɪ ˈkɑnɑt tʌtʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 專戶的話，我自己也動不了那筆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neither can the owner, rules bind both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪðər kæn ði ˈonər rulz baɪnd boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 房東也動不了，規則把兩邊綁住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Binding both sides, that is comforting news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbaɪndɪŋ boʊθ saɪdz ðæt ɪz ˈkʌmfərtɪŋ nuz/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都被綁住，這消息讓人安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfort comes later, what can it cover?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmfərt kʌmz ˈleɪtər wʌt kæn ɪt ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 安心是後話，押金能用在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I leave holes in the painted wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ liv hoʊlz ɪn ðə ˈpeɪntɪd wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 假設我在漆牆上留了洞？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small nail holes stay yours to fill.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl neɪl hoʊlz steɪ jʊrz tu fɪl/
dialogue.zh: 小釘孔那一處要你自己補。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filling holes, I will bring cheap paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪlɪŋ hoʊlz aɪ wɪl brɪŋ tʃip peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 補洞我會自備便宜的補土。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paste, sandpaper, then paint a small square.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪst ˈsændˌpeɪpər ðɛn peɪnt ə smɔl skwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 補土、砂紙，再刷一小方塊漆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paint a square, the color must match exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪnt ə skwɛr ðə ˈkʌlər mʌst mætʃ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 那一塊的漆色要完全對上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The can sits on the utility shelf, top row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæn sɪts ɑn ðə jutəˈlɪti ʃɛlf tɑp roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 油漆罐就在工具架最上面那排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top row noted, what else takes deposit money?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp roʊ ˈnoʊtəd wʌt ɛls teɪks dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那排記下了，還有什麼會扣押金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carpet stains, broken glass, missing keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑrpɪt steɪnz ˈbroʊkən ɡlæs ˈmɪsɪŋ kiz/
dialogue.zh: 地毯污漬、破掉的玻璃、不見的鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing keys cost a whole lock change?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ kiz kɔst ə hoʊl lɑk tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙不見，要換整組鎖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One lost key, thirty, no full change.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɔst ki ˈθɜrti noʊ fʊl tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 掉一把只收三十，不用全換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty is bearable, I will use a hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ɪz ˈbɛrəbəl aɪ wɪl juz ə hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 三十還承受得住，我會用掛鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hooks for coats, keys in your pocket, safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʊks fɔr koʊts kiz ɪn jʊr ˈpɑkɪt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 外套掛鉤，鑰匙放口袋，最安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the papers, this stack is the lease?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈpeɪpərz ðɪs stæk ɪz ðə lis/
dialogue.zh: 現在看文件，這一疊就是租約？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six pages, plus the condition report.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈpeɪdʒəz plʌs ðə kənˈdɪʃən rɪˈport/
dialogue.zh: 六頁，外加一份屋況報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Condition report, we write it together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈdɪʃən rɪˈport wi raɪt ɪt təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 屋況報告是我們兩個人一起寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read each line, you add your notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rid itʃ laɪn ju æd jʊr noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 我唸每一行，你在旁邊加註解。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notes like the yellow corner in bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊts laɪk ðə ˈjɛloʊ ˈkɔrnər ɪn bæθ/
dialogue.zh: 註記像浴室那個發黃的角落？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write it, then photograph it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt ɪt ðɛn ˈfoʊtəˌɡræf ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，寫下來，再拍兩張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photographs dated, do you stamp dates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtəˌɡræfs ˈdeɪtəd du ju stæmp deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 照片要附日期，你們會蓋章嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your phone date is enough for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr foʊn deɪt ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 你手機裡的日期對我們就夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enough proof, then we sign page four?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf pruf ðɛn wi saɪn peɪdʒ fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 證據夠了，那要在第四頁簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Initial every page, sign only the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnɪʃəl ˈɛvri peɪdʒ saɪn ˈoʊnli ðə læst/
dialogue.zh: 每頁寫姓名縮寫，最後一頁才簽全名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short name on each page, I can manage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt neɪm ɑn itʃ peɪdʒ aɪ kən ˈmænɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 每頁簽短名，這我辦得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, look at clause twelve, the dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʊk æt klɔs twɛlv ðə deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好，來看第十二條，租期日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve starts the first, ends next July.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv stɑrts ðə fɜrst ɛndz nɛkst dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 第十二條從一號起，到明年七月結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A year exactly, then you decide again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə jɪr ɪɡˈzæktli ðɛn ju dɪˈsaɪd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 整整一年，之後你再決定一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Decide again, or is renewal automatic?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsaɪd əˈɡɛn ɔr ɪz rɪˈnul ˌɔtəˈmætɪk/
dialogue.zh: 再決定一次，還是續約是自動的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing automatic, we ask you in May.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˌɔtəˈmætɪk wi æsk ju ɪn meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有自動這回事，五月我們會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask in May, then I sleep easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪn meɪ ðɛn aɪ slip ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 五月會有人問，那我就能睡輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep easy, but notice needs two months.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈizi bʌt ˈnoʊtɪs nidz tu mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆睡吧，但要搬得提前兩個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two months notice, that is a hard date.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌnθs ˈnoʊtɪs ðæt ɪz ə hɑrd deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩個月的通知期，那是硬日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hard, because rent runs while you search.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrd bɪˈkɔz rɛnt rʌnz waɪl ju sɜrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 很硬，因為你找房時租金照跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rent while I search, I must plan early.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛnt waɪl aɪ sɜrtʃ aɪ mʌst plæn ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 找屋期間房租照付，我要早點規劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calendar reminders solve this for most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæləˌndər rɪˈmaɪndərz sɑːlv ðɪs fɔr moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 對多數人，行事曆提醒就解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reminder set, now the rent increase line.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmaɪndər sɛt naʊ ðə rɛnt ɪnˈkris laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 提醒設好了，那調漲那一句呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One increase a year, capped at five percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪnˈkris ə jɪr kæpt æt faɪv pɜrˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 一年只調一次，上限百分之五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Capped at five, is that signed by him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæpt æt faɪv ɪz ðæt saɪnd baɪ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 上限五個百分點，他有簽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owner initials page two, look, there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈonər ɪˈnɪʃəlz peɪdʒ tu lʊk ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 業主在第二頁簽了縮名，就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, small ink, big comfort.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz smɔl ɪŋk bɪɡ ˈkʌmfərt/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，字跡小，安心大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfort has a price, the guarantor form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmfərt hæz ə praɪs ðə ˈɡærəntɔr fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 安心也有代價，就是保證人表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guarantor means my brother could sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡærəntɔr minz maɪ ˈbrʌðər kʊd saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 保證人是指我哥哥也能簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any adult with steady income, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈædʌlt wɪð ˈstɛdi ˈɪnkʌm jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 任何收入穩定的成年人都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady income yes, for one full year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi ˈɪnkʌm jɛs fɔr wʌn fʊl jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 他的收入很穩定，已經滿一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he fills a page, we call to check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi fɪlz ə peɪdʒ wi kɔl tu tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 那請他填一頁，我們會打電話核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calling my brother, is that awkward there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔlɪŋ maɪ ˈbrʌðər ɪz ðæt ˈɔkwərd ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 打給我哥確認，會不會很尷尬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three short questions, salary, job, years.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ʃɔrt ˈkwɛstʃənz ˈsæləri dʒɑb jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 只三個短問題：薪資、工作、年資。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple enough, he answers everything fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ɪˈnʌf hi ˈænsərz ˈɛvriθɪŋ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 不難，他什麼問題都答得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the money order for month one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ðə ˈmʌni ˈɔrdər fɔr mʌnθ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，接著是第一個月費用的順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deposit wired first, and what comes after?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈpɑzɪt waɪərd fɜrst ænd wʌt kʌmz ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 押金先匯過去，後面依序是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The agency fee, then your first month rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈeɪdʒənsi fi ðɛn jʊr fɜrst mʌnθ rɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 再來是仲介費，然後是你第一個月的房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deposit twenty four hundred, the fee six hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈhʌndrəd ðə fi sɪks ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 押金兩千四，仲介費六百。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First rent twelve hundred, forty two hundred total.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst rɛnt twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 第一期房租一千二，總共四千二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With my cat, is it fifty four hundred?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪθ maɪ kæt ɪz ɪt ˈfɪfti fɔr ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 加上我的貓，是五千四百嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fifty four, keep every wire receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈfɪfti fɔr kip ˈɛvri waɪər rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 對，五千四百，每一張匯款收據都要留。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt printed, banks give one by mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsit ˈprɪntɪd bæŋkz ɡiv wʌn baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 收據會印出來，銀行也寄送。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Download it too, paper can be lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌdaʊnˈloʊd ɪt tu ˈpeɪpər kən bi lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 也下載一份，紙本會弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Download saved, what if rent is late once?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌdaʊnˈloʊd seɪvd wʌt ɪf rɛnt ɪz leɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 下載存好了，萬一遲繳一次呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call first, late calls beat silent weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl fɜrst leɪt kɔlz bit ˈsaɪlənt wikz/
dialogue.zh: 先打電話來說，主動講勝過沉默。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silent weeks, that was my last housemate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪlənt wikz ðæt wʌz maɪ læst ˈhaʊsˌmeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一聲不吭地拖，我上一個室友就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cases like his taught me, I call first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæsɪz laɪk hɪz tɔt mi aɪ kɔl fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 這種案例教會我，現在我都先開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Opening early keeps both sides friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpənɪŋ ˈɜrli kips boʊθ saɪdz ˈfrɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 提早把話說開，雙方關係才友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad we agree, now the sublet clause.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd wi əˈɡri naʊ ðə sʌbˈlɛt klɔs/
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們想法一致，來看轉租那一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sublet means my room rented to another?
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌbˈlɛt minz maɪ rum ˈrɛntɪd tu əˈnʌðər/
dialogue.zh: 轉租是指我那間租給別人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with written consent, never casually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɪð ˈrɪtən kənˈsɛnt ˈnɛvər ˈkæʒəwəli/
dialogue.zh: 一定要有書面同意，不能私下隨意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Written consent, that protects Nina too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtən kənˈsɛnt ðæt prəˈtɛkts ˈninə tu/
dialogue.zh: 書面同意這件事，也保護了妮娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no stranger sleeps there without asking.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs noʊ ˈstreɪndʒər slips ðɛr wɪˈðaʊt ˈæskɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，沒問過一聲，陌生人不準在屋裡睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleeping strangers, no, I agree fully.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipɪŋ ˈstreɪndʒərz noʊ aɪ əˈɡri ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 讓陌生人住進來，我完全反對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then only the pet clause is left open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈoʊnli ðə pɛt klɔz ɪz lɛft ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 那就只剩養寵那一條還開放著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pet clause, my cat needs one line there.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛt klɔz maɪ kæt nidz wʌn laɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 養寵那條，我的貓需要一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says one cat, indoor only, no dogs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz wʌn kæt ˌɪnˈdɔr ˈoʊnli noʊ dɔɡz/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫一隻貓、只在室內、不養狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Indoor only, my cat is an indoor cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnˈdɔr ˈoʊnli maɪ kæt ɪz ən ˌɪnˈdɔr kæt/
dialogue.zh: 只在室內，牠本來就是室內貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, then that clause needs no change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðɛn ðæt klɔz nidz noʊ tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那一條就完全不用改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No change, so what is left for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃeɪndʒ soʊ wʌt ɪz lɛft fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 不用改，那還剩下什麼給我做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two signatures and one date at bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsɪɡnətʃərz ænd wʌn deɪt æt ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 兩個簽名，還有最下面寫個日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Date today, or the day I actually move?
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪt təˈdeɪ ɔr ðə deɪ aɪ ˈæktʃuəli muv/
dialogue.zh: 日期簽今天，還是真正搬進去那天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today, since today is when we agree.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ sɪns təˈdeɪ ɪz wɛn wi əˈɡri/
dialogue.zh: 今天就對，因為今天是我們點頭的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Agreement day, then I keep one copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrimənt deɪ ðɛn aɪ kip wʌn ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 達成共識這天，那我保留一份？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two copies, scan one, photo the last page.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑpiz skæn wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ ðə læst peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 兩份，掃一份，最後一頁再拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photo filed, my folder grows one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈfaɪld maɪ ˈfoʊldər ɡroʊz wʌn mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 照片歸檔，我的資料夾又多一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That folder is your shield in disputes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈfoʊldər ɪz jʊr ʃild ɪn dɪˈsjuts/
dialogue.zh: 那疊文件是你發生糾紛時的護身符。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shield ready, so when do I pay deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃild ˈrɛdi soʊ wɛn du aɪ peɪ dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 護身備好了，那押金何時繳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After your application is approved by us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər jʊr ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən ɪz əˈpruvd baɪ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 等你的申請通過我們審核之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Approved first, so nothing paid today then.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpruvd fɜrst soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ peɪd təˈdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 先核準，那今天一分錢都不用繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a cent, just your application papers.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə sɛnt dʒʌst jʊr ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən ˈpeɪpərz/
dialogue.zh: 連一毛都不用，只交申請文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Application papers, I will type them tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən ˈpeɪpərz aɪ wɪl taɪp ðɛm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 申請文件啊，我今晚就開始打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type slowly, wrong dates delay everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ˈsloʊli rɔŋ deɪts dɪˈleɪ ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢打，日期寫錯會耽誤全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delay is what I fear most, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈleɪ ɪz wʌt aɪ fɪr moʊst ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 我最怕的事情就是拖延。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fear is fine, but check clause twelve again.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪr ɪz faɪn bʌt tʃɛk klɔz twɛlv əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 怕沒關係，但請再核一次第十二條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clause twelve, dates, notice, increase, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔz twɛlv deɪts ˈnoʊtɪs ɪnˈkris dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 第十二條：日期、通知、調漲，看完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done well, you read like a careful tenant.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn wɛl ju rid laɪk ə ˈkɛrfəl ˈtɛnənt/
dialogue.zh: 讀得仔細，你像個很小心的房客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Application form on the lobby table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən fɔrm ɑn ðə ˈlɑbi ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 申請表放在大廳的桌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, page one, black ink only.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs peɪdʒ wʌn blæk ɪŋk ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 對，第一頁，只能用黑筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black ink, why not a blue pen?
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ɪŋk waɪ nɑt ə blu pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 黑筆，為什麼不能用藍色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue fades inside the scanner copies.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu feɪdz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈskænər ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 藍色的在掃描影本裡會褪淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scanner copies, so my writing matters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskænər ˈkɑpiz soʊ maɪ ˈraɪtɪŋ ˈmætərz/
dialogue.zh: 是掃描件，所以我寫的要清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write your name exactly as your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt jʊr neɪm ɪɡˈzæktli æz jʊr kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 名字要寫得跟證件上一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly as my identity card says?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli æz maɪ aɪˈdɛntəti kɑrd sɛz/
dialogue.zh: 完全照身分證上的寫法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same spelling, same order, no nickname.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈspɛlɪŋ seɪm ˈɔrdər noʊ ˈnɪkneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 拼法一樣、順序一樣，不能寫暱稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No nickname, and the card copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈnɪkneɪm ænd ðə kɑrd ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 不寫暱稱，那證件影本呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the front side and the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə frʌnt saɪd ænd ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 正面跟背面都要影印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both sides on one page, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ saɪdz ɑn wʌn peɪdʒ ɪz ðæt faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩面放同一頁，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One page works, keep it readable.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn peɪdʒ wɜrks kip ɪt ˈrɪdəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 一頁就行，要看得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Readable done, pay slips how many?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪdəbəl dʌn peɪ slɪps haʊ ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 清楚就好，薪資單要幾張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two recent slips, June and July.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈrisənt slɪps dʒun ænd dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 最近兩張，六月跟七月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June and July, why not May also?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒun ænd dʒʊˈlaɪ waɪ nɑt meɪ ˈɔlsoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 六月跟七月，五月為什麼不算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May looks too old for the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ lʊks tu oʊld fɔr ðə faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 五月在申請檔裡太舊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two slips, plus a letter from work?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu slɪps plʌs ə ˈlɛtər frʌm wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 兩張單子，再加上公司開的證明信？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one line with your gross salary.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn laɪn wɪð jʊr ɡros ˈsæləri/
dialogue.zh: 對，裡面要寫一行薪資總額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gross salary, the job title too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡros ˈsæləri ðə dʒɑb ˈtaɪtəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 薪資總額，職稱也要寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Title, start date, and a phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪtəl stɑrt deɪt ænd ə foʊn ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 職稱、到職日，還有公司電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A work phone, they will call it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɜrk foʊn ðeɪ wɪl kɔl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 公司的電話，他們會真的打？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, so warn your boss tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi soʊ wɔrn jʊr bɔs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可能，所以你今晚先跟主管說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warn my boss, easy. Old landlord then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrn maɪ bɔs ˈizi oʊld ˈlændlɔrd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 跟主管說，簡單。那前房東呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One short call to Mr Ho.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃɔrt kɔl tu ˈmɪstər hoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只要打一通簡短的電話給何先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One call, and what does he confirm?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl ænd wʌt dʌz hi kənˈfɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 一通電話，他會證實什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your rent always paid on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr rɛnt ˈɔlweɪz peɪd ɑn taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你的租金一向按時繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid on time, that part is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd ɑn taɪm ðæt pɑrt ɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 按時繳過，那部分是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, write his number in this box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd raɪt hɪz ˈnʌmbər ɪn ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 很好，把他的電話寫在這一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His number in, reason for moving now?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ˈnʌmbər ɪn ˈrizən fɔr ˈmuvɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 電話寫進去了，那搬家理由呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shorter commute, say that honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtər kəˈmjuːt seɪ ðæt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 通勤變近了，誠實這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly is best, anything else asked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ɪz bɛst ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls æskt/
dialogue.zh: 誠實最好，還會問別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emergency contact, one person name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈmɜrdʒənsi ˈkɑntækt wʌn ˈpɜrsən neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 緊急聯絡人，一位的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One person, my sister counts fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpɜrsən maɪ ˈsɪstər kaʊnts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一位就好，我姊可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her name, her phone, her city.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr neɪm hɜr foʊn hɜr ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 她的名字、電話，還有住的城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her city is Taichung, still acceptable?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr ˈsɪti ɪz ˌtaɪˈdʒʊŋ stɪl əkˈsɛptəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 她住台中，這樣也還可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far cities work for emergencies.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr ˈsɪtiz wɜrk fɔr ɪˈmɜrdʒənsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 住得遠對緊急聯絡沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emergencies set, bank statement next?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈmɜrdʒənsɪz sɛt bæŋk ˈsteɪtmənt nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 緊急聯絡設好了，再來是銀行對帳單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three months, printed from your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mʌnθs ˈprɪntɪd frʌm jʊr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 三個月的，從你的手機印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the phone, plain or signed copies?
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə foʊn pleɪn ɔr saɪnd ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 從手機印，是一般影本還是蓋章的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain print is enough, no stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn prɪnt ɪz ɪˈnʌf noʊ stæmp/
dialogue.zh: 一般列印就夠，不用蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No stamp, then guarantor papers now?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stæmp ðɛn ˈɡærəntɔr ˈpeɪpərz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用蓋章，那保證人的文件呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your brother signs the same page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈbrʌðər saɪnz ðə seɪm peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 你哥哥在同一頁簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same page, does he come here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm peɪdʒ dʌz hi kʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 同一頁，他今天要親自來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, his signature scan works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hɪz ˈsɪɡnətʃər skæn wɜrks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，掃瞄他的簽名就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A scan of his, plus his pay slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə skæn ʌv hɪz plʌs hɪz peɪ slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 掃他的簽名，再加他的薪資單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One slip proves steady income there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn slɪp pruvz ˈstɛdi ˈɪnkʌm ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 一張單就證明他那邊的穩定收入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady income done, a photo for the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi ˈɪnkʌm dʌn ə ˈfoʊtoʊ fɔr ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 收入穩定了，門禁卡的照片呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The building card needs one head shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈbɪldɪŋ kɑrd nidz wʌn hɛd ʃɑt/
dialogue.zh: 大樓門禁卡要一張大頭照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One head shot, print it today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɛd ʃɑt prɪnt ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一張大頭照，今天列印？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it with your paperless file.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt wɪð jʊr ˈpeɪpərlɪs faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 跟著你的無紙申請檔一起傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paperless file, where do I send?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərlɪs faɪl wɛr du aɪ sɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 無紙檔案，我要傳到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reply to my mail, subject Rental.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈplaɪ tu maɪ mel ˈsʌbdʒɪk ˈrɛntəl/
dialogue.zh: 回我的信，主旨寫租房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Subject Rental, deadline when exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌbdʒɪk ˈrɛntəl ˈdɛdlaɪn wɛn ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 主旨寫租房，截止是幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday noon, twelve sharp please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ nun twɛlv ʃɑrp pliz/
dialogue.zh: 星期二中午，十二點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve sharp, that is three days away.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ʃɑrp ðæt ɪz θri deɪz əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 十二點整，也就是還有三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough time if you start tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf taɪm ɪf ju stɑrt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要你今晚就開始，時間就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start tonight, then what happens after?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt təˈnaɪt ðɛn wʌt ˈhæpənz ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 今晚開始，之後會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner reads, agency checks notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈonər ridz ˈeɪdʒənsi tʃɛks noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 房東看，經紀公司核對紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of them read it, how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ʌv ðɛm rid ɪt haʊ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都會看，要看多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two working days, sometimes four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈwɜrkɪŋ deɪz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 兩個工作日，有時候四天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four days possible, so I wait quietly?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr deɪz ˈpɑsəbəl soʊ aɪ weɪt ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 可能四天，那我就安靜等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, then call Thursday after ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛn kɔl ˈθɜrzdeɪ ˈæftər tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 等，然後星期四十點後再打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, Rachel, your direct line still?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzdeɪ ˈreɪtʃəl jʊr dəˈrɛkt laɪn stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 星期四，瑞秋，你的直撥號還在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same number, office opens nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈnʌmbər ˈɔfəs ˈoʊpənz naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 同一支，辦公室九點開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine then, that office line rings long?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðɛn ðæt ˈɔfəs laɪn rɪŋz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 九點，那支辦公電話會響很久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rings, someone answers by three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɪŋz ˈsʌmwʌn ˈænsərz baɪ θri/
dialogue.zh: 會響，三聲內就有人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By three rings, good to know that.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ θri rɪŋz ɡʊd tu noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 三聲內，知道就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your spam folder daily too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk jʊr spæm ˈfoʊldər ˈdeɪli tu/
dialogue.zh: 你也要每天查垃圾信夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spam folder checked, a reply means what?
dialogue.phonetic: /spæm ˈfoʊldər tʃɛkt ə rɪˈplaɪ minz wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 垃圾夾會查，有回覆代表什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes or no, both in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔr noʊ boʊθ ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 同意或拒絕，都會白紙黑字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In writing, what if the answer is no?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ wʌt ɪf ði ˈænsər ɪz noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 會寫下來，如果答案是拒絕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They give a reason, usually income.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡiv ə ˈrizən ˈjuʒəwəli ˈɪnkʌm/
dialogue.zh: 他們會給理由，多半是收入不足。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Usually income, can I send again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli ˈɪnkʌm kæn aɪ sɛnd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 多半是收入，我可以再送一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next month, with two new slips.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ wɪð tu nju slɪps/
dialogue.zh: 下個月，附兩張新的薪資單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two new slips, is my chance still fair?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu nju slɪps ɪz maɪ tʃæns stɪl fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 兩張新單子，我的機會還公道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three files competed for this flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri faɪlz kəmˈpɛtɪd fɔr ðɪs flæt/
dialogue.zh: 這間有三份申請在比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three in contention, waiting feels heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪn kənˈtɛnʃən ˈweɪtɪŋ filz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 三份在搶，等起來就沉重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting is the hardest part here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪtɪŋ ɪz ðə ˈhɑrdəst pɑrt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 等待本身最難熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hardest part accepted, then what news comes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdəst pɑrt əkˈsɛptɪd ðɛn wʌt nuz kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 最難的我接受，然後會有什麼消息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Approval text, then wire that evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpruːvəl tɛkst ðɛn waɪər ðæt ˈivənɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 通過的簡訊，當晚就匯押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wire the deposit, keep the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪər ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt kip ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 匯押金，收據要留著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photograph both sides of that slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtəɡræf boʊθ saɪdz ʌv ðæt slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 那張匯款單兩面都拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both sides shot, where does money land?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ saɪdz ʃɑt wɛr dʌz ˈmʌni lænd/
dialogue.zh: 兩面都拍，錢會進到哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The protected account, receipt by mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði prəˈtɛktɪd əˈkaʊnt rɪˈsit baɪ mel/
dialogue.zh: 保護帳戶，收據用郵件寄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt by mail, is the contract ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsit baɪ mel ɪz ðə ˈkɑntrækt ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 收據寄郵件，合約就緒了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signed version waits, bring your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd ˈvɜrʒən weɪts brɪŋ jʊr kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 簽好的版本放著，帶證件來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring my card, signing when exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ maɪ kɑrd ˈsaɪnɪŋ wɛn ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 帶我的證件，簽約是幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday ten, lobby, pen included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ tɛn ˈlɑbi pɛn ɪnˈkludɪd/
dialogue.zh: 星期六十點，在大廳，筆備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pen ready, first rent due with signing?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛn ˈrɛdi fɜrst rɛnt du wɪð ˈsaɪnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 筆備好了，第一期租金簽約時繳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve hundred with the signature.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd wɪð ðə ˈsɪɡnətʃər/
dialogue.zh: 一千二，跟簽名一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signature plus rent, then keys today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɡnətʃər plʌs rɛnt ðɛn kiz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 簽名加租金，今天拿鑰匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys after the walk through, noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz ˈæftər ðə wɔk θru nun/
dialogue.zh: 走完檢查表才給，約中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk through at noon, how many keys?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk θru æt nun haʊ ˈmɛni kiz/
dialogue.zh: 中午走檢查，鑰匙有幾把？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three door keys, mailbox, buzzer fob.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri dɔr kiz ˈmeɪlˌbɑks ˈbʌzər fɑb/
dialogue.zh: 三把門鑰、信箱鑰、對講磁扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small fob, lost means money?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl fɑb lɔst minz ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 小小的磁扣，弄丟了要賠錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty, so keep it on your ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti soʊ kip ɪt ɑn jʊr rɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四十元，把它扣在你的鑰匙圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On my ring, elevator for the move?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn maɪ rɪŋ ˈɛləˌveɪtər fɔr ðə muv/
dialogue.zh: 記下了扣好，搬家那天用電梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hour slot, nine to eleven booked.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊər slɑt naɪn tu ɪˈlɛvən bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 兩小時時段，九點到十一點訂好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine to eleven, thank you for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn tu ɪˈlɛvən θæŋk ju fɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 九到十一點，謝謝你今天帶我看完全程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One call away, and Cedar twelve is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl əˈweɪ ænd ˈsidər twɛlv ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 只差一通電話，雪松街十二號就是你的了。
